Authors: Jincheng Li, Yutian Zhang, Jianyu Zhang, Xinshun Wang, Mengyuan Liu

Seeing Beyond the Next Step: World-Model-Guided Human-Like Navigation in Multi-Agent Scenes WorldModel

world model human-aware navigation preference distillation action-conditioned prediction multi-agent scenes

简要说明：本文提出在训练时使用世界模型作为偏好预言机，将远见蒸馏到快速单步导航策略中，在无需在线推演的情况下实现更安全、更类人的多智能体场景导航。

TLDR: The paper proposes using world models at training time as preference oracles to distill foresight into a fast, single-pass navigation policy, achieving more human-like and safer navigation in multi-agent scenes without online rollouts.

Abstract: Selecting a next motion in a populated scene is not just a matter of avoiding what is currently in the way: an action can be locally feasible yet drift onto the road instead of the crosswalk, cut into a stream of crossing pedestrians, or bottleneck a narrow passage. These failure modes are invisible from the current state alone, and acting on them requires reasoning about what each candidate action will cause. World models offer exactly this, namely action-conditioned predictions of the future, but rolling them out at every decision step is a cost deployable navigation systems cannot pay, and the field has largely traded foresight for speed. We argue this is a false dichotomy. The natural place for a world model in human-aware navigation is at training time, as a preference oracle that distills foresight into a fast policy, rather than at inference time, as an online planner. We pair a discrete visual action prior with two task-aligned world models, one for nearby social dynamics and one for future scene semantics, that score candidate actions by their predicted consequences and refine the policy through group-relative preference distillation. At deployment, both world models are removed and the policy acts in a single forward pass. Across five held-out evaluation scenarios, this yields navigation that is simultaneously safer, more socially and group-coherent, and more goal-directed than strong reactive and learned baselines, with naive observers rating the resulting motion as more human-like. Taken together, our findings point to a different approach for bringing world-model foresight into deployable agents: not accelerating rollouts, but amortizing them into the policy so that the cost of looking ahead is confined to training. Project page: https://seoneun.github.io/-NeurIPS-2026-Seeing-Beyond-the-Next-Step/

摘要（中文）：在人群密集的场景中选择下一步动作，不仅仅是避开当前障碍的问题：一个动作在局部上或许是可行的，却可能漂移离开人行横道而进入车道、切入横穿而过的行人流，或在狭窄通道造成瓶颈。这些失效模式仅从当前状态是无法察觉的，而要应对它们，需要对每个候选动作将引发的后果进行推理。世界模型恰恰提供了这种能力，即基于动作的未来状态条件预测，但在每个决策步骤中进行 rollout 的成本是实际部署的导航系统无法承受的，因此该领域在很大程度上以速度换取了前瞻性。我们认为这是一种错误的二分法。在人机共融导航中，世界模型的天然位置是在训练阶段，作为将前瞻能力蒸馏进快速策略的偏好裁判，而非在推理阶段充当在线规划器。我们将离散视觉动作先验与两个面向任务对齐的世界模型相结合——一个负责邻近社会动力学，另一个负责未来场景语义——通过预测的后果对候选动作进行评分，并通过群体相对偏好蒸馏来优化策略。部署时，两个世界模型均被移除，策略只需一次前向传播即可执行。在五个留出评估场景中，该方法相比强反应式基线和学习基线，同时实现了更安全、更具社会性与群体一致性、更目标导向的导航效果，且未经过训练的评估者认为其运动更接近人类行为。综合来看，我们的研究指向了一种将世界模型前瞻能力引入可部署智能体的不同路径：并非加速 rollout，而是将其摊销进策略之中，使前瞻的成本仅存在于训练阶段。项目主页：https://seoneun.github.io/-NeurIPS-2026-Seeing-Beyond-the-Next-Step/

Authors: Seong-Eun Hong, JuYeong Hwang, Jinhyun Kim, Hanyoung Jang, HyeongYeop Kang

Dual-Arm Tabletop Rearrangement with Movable Stacking and Gap-Aware Push Transfers Manipulation

dual-arm rearrangement movable stacking gap-aware push transfer Monte Carlo Tree Search tabletop manipulation

简要说明：本文提出一种双臂桌面重排框架，利用可移动堆叠和间隙感知推传策略实现异步跨臂物体交换，并通过联合MCTS规划器降低执行成本，在密集场景中优于固定交接基线。

TLDR: This paper presents a dual-arm tabletop rearrangement framework using movable stacking and a gap-aware push transfer strategy to enable asynchronous inter-arm object exchange, with a joint MCTS-based planner minimizing execution cost, showing advantages in dense scenes.

Abstract: Object rearrangement in cluttered tabletop scenes is challenging, especially in wide workspaces where dual-arm systems improve coverage and efficiency. Limited free space often necessitates buffering, while objects near or across the shared reachability region of the manipulators must be transferred under careful coordination to avoid inter-arm collisions. Conventional inter-arm transfer typically relies on a fixed handoff configuration, which constrains where and how objects are exchanged, enforces spatiotemporal synchronization of the arms, and reduces flexibility in dense layouts. This paper presents a dual-arm rearrangement framework that combines movable stacking with Gap-Aware Push Transfer for asynchronous cross-boundary exchange. The method scans the shared boundary to identify collision-free transfer gaps, places an object near a selected crossing point, and then pushes it into the receiving workspace without requiring simultaneous interaction between the two arms. A joint Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-based planner coordinates both manipulators while reasoning over buffering and transfer decisions, and execution cost is used after planning to assess the resulting plan. Experiments show that the proposed method shortens joint execution sequences and becomes increasingly advantageous over a fixed handoff baseline as scene density increases, achieving lower execution cost in denser scenes while remaining competitive in lighter ones.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱桌面场景中的物体重排具有挑战性，尤其是在广域工作空间中，双臂系统可提升覆盖范围和效率。有限的空闲空间通常需要缓冲操作，而位于机械臂共享可达区域附近或跨越该区域的物体必须在精细协调下进行交接，以避免机械臂间碰撞。传统的臂间交接通常依赖固定的交接构型，这限制了物体交换的位置和方式，强制双臂时空同步，并降低了在密集布局中的灵活性。本文提出了一种双臂重排框架，结合可移动堆叠与间隙感知推送交接，实现异步跨边界物体交换。该方法扫描共享边界以识别无碰撞交接间隙，将物体放置在选定的穿越点附近，然后将其推入接收工作空间，无需两臂同时交互。基于联合蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的规划器协调两只机械臂，同时对缓冲与交接决策进行推理，并在规划后使用执行代价评估所生成的方案。实验表明，所提方法缩短了联合执行序列，且随着场景密度增加，相较于固定交接基线具有越来越明显的优势，在较密集场景中实现更低执行代价，同时在较稀疏场景中保持竞争力。

Authors: Mohammadreza Firoozalizadeh, Zakiye Rostamirad, Arman Barghi, Ahmad Kalhor, Mohammadreza Nayeri, Mehdi Tale Masouleh

PhySA: Decoupling Aesthetic and Physical Rewards for Humanoid Locomotion HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid locomotion vision-language models reward design smoothness PPO

简要说明：PhySA将美学VLM奖励与基于物理的平滑惩罚分离，以减少人形机器人运动中的关节加速度，在MuJoCo中有所改善但迁移有限。

TLDR: PhySA decouples aesthetic VLM rewards from physics-based smoothness penalties to reduce joint acceleration in humanoid locomotion, showing improvements in MuJoCo but limited transfer.

Abstract: Humanoid locomotion policies trained without an explicit smoothness objective tend to produce jerky, high-energy gaits that stress actuators. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer an appealing reward source: given a rendered rollout, a VLM returns an aesthetic quality score on [0,10] without task-specific feature engineering. We find, however, that aesthetic preference and physical smoothness point in opposite directions: across four production VLMs, clips with higher joint acceleration receive higher aesthetic scores (mean Pearson r=+0.66). We study PhySA (Physical Smoothness and Aesthetics), which keeps the two on separate, independently removable reward channels: a sparse, asynchronous VLM score and a phase-triggered correction channel that adjusts physical penalty weights from simulator state. Ablations attribute the smoothness gain to the correction channel. On MuJoCo Humanoid-v5 at 2.6M steps, PhySA lowers joint acceleration by 26 to 32% relative to vanilla PPO, Text2Reward, and Eureka (three seeds), at the cost of shorter episodes. In a single extended run it lowers joint acceleration by 59.5% relative to Prompt2Policy, while a three-seed replication shows a smaller, non-significant reduction (7.2%). The gain does not transfer to IsaacLab or the Unitree G1, even after rescaling the smoothness term.

摘要（中文）：人体动作控制策略若缺少显式的平滑性目标，往往会产生急促、高能耗的步态，对执行器造成较大压力。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）提供了一种颇具吸引力的奖励来源：给定一段渲染出的动作序列，VLM无需针对特定任务的特征工程，即可返回一个[0,10]区间内的美学质量评分。然而，我们发现美学偏好与物理平滑性指向相反方向：在四种主流VLM中，关节加速度更高的片段获得了更高的美学评分（平均Pearson相关系数r=+0.66）。我们研究了PhySA（物理平滑性与美学）方法，该方法将两者保持在独立且可分别移除的奖励通道上：一个稀疏、异步的VLM评分通道和一个由相位触发的校正通道，后者根据模拟器状态调整物理惩罚权重。消融实验将平滑性提升归因于校正通道。在MuJoCo Humanoid-v5上，经过260万步训练，与标准PPO、Text2Reward和Eureka相比（三种随机种子），PhySA将关节加速度降低了26%至32%，但代价是回合长度缩短。在单次扩展运行中，相对于Prompt2Policy，PhySA将关节加速度降低了59.5%；而三次种子重复实验则显示出较小且不显著的降幅（7.2%）。该提升效果未迁移至IsaacLab或Unitree G1，即便重新调整平滑项的权重系数亦然。

Authors: Yunwan Fu, Sicheng He, Jiageng Mao, Yue Wang

Energy-Aware Open-Vocabulary Detection Scheduling for Low-Power Robotic Autonomy Perception3D

energy-aware scheduling open-vocabulary detection low-power robotics YOLO-World navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向低功耗移动机器人的能量感知开放词汇目标检测调度器，根据机器人状态动态切换YOLO-World-S模式，在保持任务成功率的同时降低功耗，并在Jetson Orin Nano上通过40次真实导航试验验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces an energy-aware scheduler for open-vocabulary object detection on low-power mobile robots, dynamically switching between YOLO-World-S modes based on robot state to reduce power consumption while maintaining task success, validated on a Jetson Orin Nano with 40 real navigation trials.

Abstract: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) lets robots search for run-time object queries, but fixed-rate inference spends embedded compute on low-value frames during idle motion, map revisits, or stable viewpoints. This paper presents an energy-aware OVD scheduler for low-power mobile robots. The scheduler uses odometry, map change, and detector confidence to switch among low-, mid-, and high-power YOLO-World-S modes on a Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate the energy-quality trade-off on an AgileX LIMO using 40 real navigation trials: two target objects, five placements per target-policy pair, and four perception policies. Across bottle and cup trials, the scheduler records 8/10 mission success compared with 7/10 for each fixed-rate baseline, while reducing mean Jetson input power (a Jetson-side power-draw metric) by 5.2% relative to an 8 Hz high-rate baseline and lowering achieved OVD call rate by 34.0%. It does not minimize mission-window Jetson input energy because longer missions can erase instantaneous power savings. A separate 60 s stationary microbenchmark isolates the perception workload: the scheduler lowers mean power from 8.045 W to 7.301 W and energy from 484.7 J to 438.1 J relative to the 8 Hz baseline. These results support robot-state-aware OVD scheduling as a promising power-management mechanism with competitive task reliability, while showing that mission-window Jetson input energy must be read together with task progress and runtime.

摘要（中文）：开放词汇目标检测（OVD）使机器人能够在运行时搜索目标查询，但固定频率的推理在空闲运动、地图重访或稳定视角期间会将嵌入式算力浪费在低价值帧上。本文提出了一种面向低功耗移动机器人的能量感知OVD调度器。该调度器利用里程计、地图变化和检测置信度，在Jetson Orin Nano上的低、中、高功耗YOLO-World-S模式之间进行切换。我们在AgileX LIMO上通过40次真实导航试验评估了能量与质量的权衡：两个目标物体、每个目标-策略组合五种放置位置以及四种感知策略。在瓶子和杯子试验中，调度器实现了8/10的任务成功率，而每个固定频率基线均为7/10，同时相对于8 Hz高频基线，Jetson平均输入功率（一种Jetson侧功耗指标）降低了5.2%，实现的OVD调用率降低了34.0%。调度器并未最小化任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量，因为更长的任务持续时间可能会抵消瞬时功耗节省。一项独立的60秒静态微基准测试隔离了感知工作负载：相对于8 Hz基线，调度器将平均功率从8.045 W降至7.301 W，能量从484.7 J降至438.1 J。这些结果支持将机器人状态感知的OVD调度作为一种有前景的功耗管理机制，其在任务可靠性方面具有竞争力，同时也表明任务窗口内的Jetson输入能量必须与任务进展和运行时间一起综合分析。

Authors: Abdul Basit, Muhammad Shafique

GraspBench: Execution-Aware Cross-Robot Evaluation of 6-DoF Grasp Generation in MuJoCo Manipulation

6-DoF grasp generation cross-robot evaluation MuJoCo simulation inverse kinematics filtering motion planning

简要说明：GraspBench 提出了一种基于 MuJoCo 的评估协议，用于跨多机器人评估完整的六自由度抓取生成流程，表明机器人本体、运动规划和执行对抓取成功率的决定性影响。

TLDR: GraspBench introduces a MuJoCo-based evaluation protocol to assess complete 6-DoF grasp-generation pipelines across multiple robots, showing that robot embodiment, motion planning, and execution critically affect grasp success beyond proposal quality.

Abstract: Modern 6-DoF grasp generators are often evaluated using grasp scores, dataset-level metrics, or single-robot demonstrations, yet proposal quality alone does not determine whether a grasp is executable by a particular robot. We present GraspBench, a controlled MuJoCo protocol for evaluating complete grasp-generation pipelines after robot-specific inverse-kinematics filtering, motion planning, and fixed approach-close-lift execution. GraspBench evaluates six configured pipelines across four robot embodiments, five diagnostic objects, and a structured tabletop pose grid, yielding 540 scenarios per method and 3,240 method-scenario evaluations in total. Missing outputs are conservatively counted as failures, and success follows the binary lift criterion produced by each method's execution runner. GraspGen achieves the highest overall success rate (73.1%), followed by EconomicGrasp (63.5%), while robot- and object-conditioned analyses reveal substantial variation across embodiments and object geometries. GPG produces the largest native candidate sets but achieves 44.3% success, indicating that proposal volume alone does not guarantee robot-executable grasps. Cluster-aware paired intervals support the principal method differences while not estimating repeated-execution uncertainty. The results characterize complete configured pipelines on fixed scenarios rather than intrinsic model quality or stochastic repeatability, showing that grasping performance depends jointly on the generator, robot embodiment, scene, and execution protocol.

摘要（中文）：现代6自由度抓取生成器通常通过抓取得分、数据集级指标或单机器人演示进行评估，然而，提案质量本身并不能决定某个抓取是否可被特定机器人执行。我们提出了GraspBench，一种受控的MuJoCo协议，用于在机器人特定的逆运动学过滤、运动规划以及固定的接近-闭合-提升执行之后，评估完整的抓取生成流水线。GraspBench在四种机器人本体、五种诊断对象和结构化桌面位姿网格上评估六种配置的流水线，每种方法产生540个场景，总计3,240个方法-场景评估。缺失输出保守计数为失败，成功遵循各方法执行运行器生成的二元提升标准。GraspGen实现了最高的总体成功率（73.1%），其次是EconomicGrasp（63.5%），而基于机器人和对象的条件分析揭示了不同本体和对象几何形状之间的显著差异。GPG生成最大的原生候选集，但仅达到44.3%的成功率，表明提案数量本身并不能保证机器人可执行的抓取。聚类感知的配对区间支持主要方法差异，但不估计重复执行的不确定性。结果表征了固定场景下完整配置的流水线，而非内在模型质量或随机可重复性，表明抓取性能共同取决于生成器、机器人本体、场景和执行协议。

Authors: Abdul Basit, Bibek Poudel, Muhammad Shafique

Real-Time Event-Based LED Tracking and Pose Estimation with PWM-Encoded Markers Perception3D

event camera LED tracking pose estimation PWM encoding drone guidance

简要说明：本文提出了一个基于事件的实时LED跟踪和6自由度姿态估计框架，利用PWM编码标记，并在协同机器人平台上展示了其在闭环无人机引导中的应用。

TLDR: This paper proposes a real-time event-based framework for LED tracking and 6-DoF pose estimation using PWM-encoded markers, and demonstrates its application in closed-loop drone guidance on a coordinated robotic platform.

Abstract: Event cameras are neuromorphic vision sensors with pixels that independently and asynchronously respond to brightness changes at microsecond resolution, supporting state estimation under rapid motion, motion blur, and high dynamic range (HDR) illumination. This also enables capture of high-frequency blinking patterns from light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Based on this, we propose a real-time event-based framework for LED tracking and six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) relative pose estimation using pulse-width modulation (PWM)-encoded LED markers. Multiple LEDs share a common blinking frequency and encode identities through distinct PWM duty cycles, reducing frequency-resource requirements and computational cost. Our dual-rate asynchronous tracking framework combines low-rate LED detection with high-rate raw-event updates, maintaining robust LED identity association and accurate pixel-level tracking under rapid motion. LED identities and positions establish reliable 2D-3D correspondences for real-time metric 6-DoF relative pose estimation. Extensive evaluations on a self-collected dataset demonstrate robustness under large motion flow and transient image-plane LED overlap. Furthermore, we develop a coordinated robotic platform comprising a quadrotor and a Mecanum-wheeled mobile robot, demonstrating the proposed framework's potential for closed-loop drone guidance through hovering and target-following experiments under time-varying HDR illumination, with onboard deployment on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. The dataset and implementation will be released to facilitate further research.

摘要（中文）：事件相机是一种神经形态视觉传感器，其像素能够独立且异步地对亮度变化作出响应，时间分辨率达微秒级，支持在快速运动、运动模糊及高动态范围（HDR）光照条件下的状态估计。这一特性也使其能够捕获发光二极管（LED）发出的高频闪烁模式。基于此，我们提出了一种实时的事件驱动框架，用于基于脉冲宽度调制（PWM）编码LED标记的LED跟踪与六自由度（6-DoF）相对位姿估计。多个LED共享同一闪烁频率，并通过不同的PWM占空比编码身份信息，从而降低频率资源需求与计算成本。我们的双速率异步跟踪框架将低速率LED检测与高速率原始事件更新相结合，在快速运动下保持稳健的LED身份关联和像素级精确跟踪。LED身份与位置为实时度量级6-DoF相对位姿估计建立了可靠的2D-3D对应关系。在自采集数据集上的广泛评估表明，该框架在大运动流量及图像平面上瞬时LED重叠场景下具有鲁棒性。此外，我们开发了一个协同机器人平台，包含一架四旋翼飞行器与一台麦克纳姆轮移动机器人，并通过悬停与目标跟踪实验，在时变HDR光照条件下验证了所提框架在闭环无人机引导方面的潜力，同时实现在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上的机载部署。数据集与实现代码将对外公开，以促进进一步研究。

Authors: Junkai Niu, Sheng Zhong, Delei Kong, Xin Wang, Kaizhen Sun, Yusen Zhang, Mingzhen Gan, Yi Zhou

Whole-Body Elasto-Geometrical Calibration of Wheeled Humanoid Robots Using a Shared-Waist Dual-Chain Model HumanoidEmbodied

Elasto-Geometrical Calibration Wheeled Humanoid Shared-Waist Dual-Chain Waist Compliance Optical Tracker

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于共享腰部双链模型的轮式人形机器人全身弹性几何标定方法，通过建立腰部和手臂的柔顺模型，在两个真实机器人上显著提高了末端执行器的精度。

TLDR: This paper presents a whole-body elasto-geometrical calibration method for wheeled humanoid robots using a shared-waist dual-chain model, which significantly improves end-effector accuracy on two real robots by modeling waist and arm compliance.

Abstract: Wheeled humanoid robots carry both arms on one actuated waist, usually without torque sensors, so the accuracy of both end-effectors depends on a single waist model. After a first stage that estimates the tracker and target extrinsics, we identify the waist and both arms in one problem from the target positions on both flanges, measured by an optical tracker. The kinematic model is complete, with waist-base, parallel-axis, and branch parameters; arm compliances are driven by measured torques and waist compliances by gravity torques of the robot's mass model; and Gaussian priors with evidence-maximizing scales stabilize the estimate. Independent and sequential single-chain calibration are restrictions of this problem, and its waist information is the sum of the single-chain Schur complements. On two robots with different waists, each without and with a payload, calibration reduces the mean errors on held-out poses from 11.3-31.1 mm to 0.50-1.11 mm. For every training-set size from 20 poses to all, the method has 17-63% lower mean errors than adaptations of two published whole-body calibration methods, mainly through the waist compliance. Independent calibration yields two waist models; using either for both arms raises the other arm's error to up to 3.21 mm.

摘要（中文）：轮式人形机器人的双臂安装于同一个主动腰部，且通常不配备力矩传感器，因此两个末端执行器的精度依赖于单一的腰部模型。在完成跟踪器与目标外部参数估计的第一阶段后，我们基于光学跟踪器测量的两个法兰上的目标位置，在单一问题中同时识别腰部及双臂参数。该运动学模型完整，包含腰部基座参数、平行轴参数及分支参数；手臂柔顺性由测量力矩驱动，腰部柔顺性由机器人质量模型的重力矩驱动；同时，采用具有证据最大化尺度的高斯先验以增强估计的稳定性。独立的单链顺序标定是该问题的特例，其腰部信息为各单链Schur补之和。在两台腰部结构不同的机器人上，分别在有无负载的情况下进行实验，标定将保留姿态上的平均误差从11.3–31.1毫米降低至0.50–1.11毫米。对于从20个姿态到全部训练集的所有规模，该方法相比两种已发表的全身标定方法的改进版本，平均误差降低17%–63%，主要归因于腰部柔顺性的建模。独立标定产生两个腰部模型；若将任一模型用于双臂，则另一只手臂的误差最高升至3.21毫米。

Authors: Pengxin Zha, Yi Lu, Haojun Ma, Jun Zhu, Minghao Qiu, Xiaoyan Wang, Wei Shan, Maoqing Yao

Embodied RAG++: Retrieval-Augmented Generation From What Exists to What Works in Embodied Scenes VLA

retrieval-augmented generation scene graphs robot-object assignment spatial reasoning embodied scenes

简要说明：提出了E2W-Bench基准和Embodied RAG++框架，通过结合场景图、产品手册和机器人能力进行空间感知的检索增强生成，在机器人-物体配对任务上显著优于基线。

TLDR: Introduces E2W-Bench and Embodied RAG++, a retrieval-augmented framework that jointly reasons over scene graphs, product manuals, and robot capabilities to assign feasible robot-object pairs under spatial and physical constraints, achieving high pair accuracy on a new benchmark.

Abstract: To serve a request in a human environment, a robot system must find an object that satisfies a functional requirement and a robot that can feasibly reach it. Scene graphs record which objects exist and where, but they often omit capabilities documented only in product manuals. Retrieval-augmented generation methods can read such manuals, yet they rarely reason jointly over object capabilities, physical instances, robot states, and dynamic connectivity. We introduce E2W-Bench, the Exists-to-Works Benchmark, which links dynamic hybrid scene graphs with real product manuals to evaluate capability-grounded robot--object assignment under availability, mobility, vertical-reach, and connector constraints. We also present Embodied RAG++, a spatially grounded retrieval framework that scopes retrieval to the manuals linked to candidate objects, caches extracted capabilities per product model, and resolves robot--object feasibility through deterministic spatial reasoning. On E2W-Bench, Embodied RAG++ reaches a pair accuracy of 0.90 with Qwen2.5-32B and 1.00 with Llama3.3-70B, compared with at most 0.30 and 0.55 for the baselines, while requiring the shortest preprocessing time among the retrieval-based methods and tying for the lowest total token count.

摘要（中文）：摘要：为在人类环境中处理请求，机器人系统必须找到满足功能要求的物体，以及能够实际到达该物体的机器人。场景图记录了哪些物体存在及其位置，但往往忽略了仅在产品手册中记载的能力信息。检索增强生成方法能够阅读此类手册，但很少对物体能力、物理实例、机器人状态和动态连接性进行联合推理。我们提出E2W-Bench（从存在到可用基准），将动态混合场景图与实际产品手册相结合，在可用性、移动性、垂直可达和连接器约束下评估基于能力的机器人-物体分配。我们还提出具身RAG++，一种空间接地检索框架，将检索范围限定在与候选物体关联的手册中，按产品型号缓存提取的能力信息，并通过确定性空间推理解决机器人-物体可行性问题。在E2W-Bench上，具身RAG++在Qwen2.5-32B上达到0.90的配对准确率，在Llama3.3-70B上达到1.00，而基线方法分别最多为0.30和0.55，同时在基于检索的方法中所需预处理时间最短，总令牌数并列最低。

Authors: Fan Yang, Tatsuya Kikuzuki, Jun Liang, Jun Liu, Wenkai Li, Ryosuke Kawamura, Ananya Hazarika, Prajit KrisshnaKumar, Shaunak Mehta, Yuushi Toyoda

Training-Independent Validation of a Learning-Based Controller for Stunt Maneuvers AutonomousDriving

learning-based control stunt maneuvers Sim2Real2Sim validation safety analysis

简要说明：本文提出一种训练无关的验证框架，用于特技驾驶学习控制器，通过Sim2Real2Sim循环和汽车安全分析识别可靠的动力学指标，并发现力与侧倾指标存在失配。

TLDR: This paper proposes a training-independent validation framework for learned stunt-driving controllers, using Sim2Real2Sim loops and automotive safety analysis to identify reliable kinematic indicators while revealing mismatches in force/roll dynamics.

Abstract: Learned controllers for vehicle maneuvers are usually validated under the conditions and objective used to train them, where they appear highly reliable, yet the parameters that change on real roads are often not those the model was trained on. We argue that validation must be independent of training: it should vary physical parameters that training kept fixed and use acceptance criteria absent from the training objective. A learning-based control policy, G-Maneuver, with 90.11% success is tested for stunt-level maneuvers. A looser terminal-heading score ranked the worst setting as the best. Because real stunt tests are safety-critical, a simulation-to-reality-to-simulation (Sim2Real2Sim) loop uses the simulation to select safe zones for real-vehicle trials with 16.9% acceptance. Automotive safety analysis frameworks are used to identify parameters for validation using coverage tests. We demonstrated that the kinematic stunt-driving indicators, namely heading change, sideslip, and speed-normalized yaw rate, match between simulation and the real world, while force and roll indicators do not, which identifies the indicators that can support safe deployment. A video of the experiments is available at https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo.

摘要（中文）：学习型车辆 maneuvers 控制器通常在其训练所使用的条件和目标下进行验证，在这种情况下它们表现出高度可靠性，然而实际道路上变化的参数往往并非模型训练时所针对的参数。我们认为验证必须独立于训练：应改变训练中保持固定的物理参数，并采用训练目标中不包含的验收标准。一种基于学习的控制策略 G-Maneuver 在特技级 maneuvers 测试中取得了 90.11% 的成功率。一个较宽松的终端航向评分将最差的设置评为最佳。由于真实特技测试关乎安全，模拟-现实-模拟（Sim2Real2Sim）循环利用模拟来为真实车辆试验选择安全区域，其接受率为 16.9%。采用汽车安全分析框架，通过覆盖测试来确定用于验证的参数。我们证明了运动学特技驾驶指标，即航向变化、侧滑和速度归一化横摆角速度，在模拟与真实世界之间相匹配，而力和侧倾指标则不匹配，这识别出了能够支持安全部署的指标。实验视频可在 https://youtu.be/dN1Oes8pNIo 观看。

Authors: Kiruthiga Chandra Shekar, Aliasghar Arab, Jingang Yi

Fast and Reliable Open-Vocabulary Object Search with Absence Detection from Robot Memory VLN

open-vocabulary object search absence detection mobile manipulator RGB observations retrieval-selection

简要说明：本文提出了一种两阶段架构，用于移动操作器中的开放词汇对象搜索，通过快速候选检索和视觉验证，从连续的RGB观测中实现高召回率和可靠的缺席检测，并在ScanNet场景和实体机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a two-stage architecture for open-vocabulary object search in mobile manipulators, using fast candidate retrieval followed by visual verification to achieve high recall and reliable absence detection from sequential RGB observations, validated in ScanNet scenes and on a real robot.

Abstract: Mobile manipulators deployed in everyday human environments, such as homes for assistive care or flexible automation, often need to locate specific objects on demand from accumulated observations. Equally important, they must reliably determine when a target is absent before committing to navigation or interaction. Existing approaches demand either slow exhaustive re-processing or expensive 3D representations, and are evaluated on recall and accuracy rather than specificity, leaving their ability to abstain on missing targets unmeasured. We find existing systems that search using text or visual embedding almost never abstain on absent objects achieving at most 9\% specificity. To support accurate search at speed, we present a two-stage architecture that decouples fast candidate retrieval from verified selection, enabling both high recall and reliable absence detection from sequential RGB observations with pose. We evaluate eight retrieval-selection configurations plus an exhaustive search baseline across ScanNet apartment scenes, including significant numbers of absent objects. Adding a visual verification step to caption-based retrieval matches or exceeds exhaustive search reliability while requiring an order of magnitude fewer detector calls. We reproduce ScanNet scores on a physical robot operating entirely on-board with a single consumer GPU running in real time.

摘要（中文）：移动操控机器人在日常人类环境中部署时（例如辅助护理或灵活自动化场景中的家庭环境），通常需要根据累积的观测按需定位特定物体。同样重要的是，在决定进行导航或交互之前，它们必须可靠地判断目标物体是否不存在。现有方法要么要求缓慢的穷举式重新处理，要么依赖昂贵的3D表示，并且仅在召回率和准确率上评估，而未考虑特异性，因此它们对缺失目标进行弃权判断的能力未被测量。我们发现，现有使用文本或视觉嵌入进行搜索的系统几乎不会对不存在的物体弃权，其特异性最多仅达9%。为了在高速搜索的同时保证准确性，我们提出了一种两阶段架构，将快速候选检索与验证选择解耦，从而能够从带位姿的连续RGB观测中实现高召回率和可靠的缺失检测。我们在ScanNet公寓场景中评估了八种检索-验证配置以及一个穷举搜索基线，并包含大量不存在的物体。在基于描述的检索流程中加入视觉验证步骤后，其可靠性达到或超过了穷举搜索，同时所需的检测器调用次数减少了一个数量级。我们在物理机器人上完全机载地复现了ScanNet评分，使用单个消费级GPU实时运行。

简要说明：本文针对一种双四连杆闭环腿机构进行了运动学建模、雅可比矩阵推导与奇异性分析，并规划了步态，在单腿试验台上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents the kinematic modeling, Jacobian derivation, and singularity analysis of a double four-bar closed-loop leg for a multimodal quadruped-aerial robot, along with gait planning and single-leg test-rig validation.

Abstract: This paper presents the kinematic modeling and singularity analysis of a three-degree-of-freedom, double four-bar closed-loop quadruped leg mechanism. This leg is essential for transitioning between the two operational modes; therefore, it is examined in both joint and task spaces, leading to the development of its Jacobian matrix, which is vital for designing the gaits required for terrestrial mode and mid-air aerial reconfiguration (for aerial mode). Various gaits are devised for the system's motion in the MATLAB simulation, and their practical implementation on the single-leg test rig is demonstrated.

摘要（中文）：本文阐述了一种三自由度、双四杆闭链四足机器人腿部机构的运动学建模与奇异性分析。该腿部机构对于两种运行模式之间的切换至关重要，因此，本文在关节空间和任务空间中分别对其进行了研究，进而推导出其雅可比矩阵，该矩阵对于设计地面模式所需的步态以及空中模式下的空中重构至关重要。在MATLAB仿真中，针对系统的运动设计了多种步态，并展示了其在单腿试验台上的实际应用实现。

Authors: Prashant Raturi, Santhakumar Mohan

FREE-LIVO: Physically Decoupled Yet Tightly Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry Perception3D

LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry tightly coupled no extrinsic calibration time synchronization-free multi-robot state estimation

简要说明：FREE-LIVO 提出了一种无需 LiDAR 与相机之间刚性外参标定和时间同步的紧耦合里程计方法，利用图像特征匹配和生成式 LiDAR 强度图像联合优化轨迹，甚至适用于传感器安装在不同机器人上的情况。

TLDR: FREE-LIVO presents a LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry method that removes the need for rigid extrinsic calibration and time synchronization between LiDAR and camera, using image feature matching and generative LiDAR intensity images to jointly optimize trajectories, even for sensors on separate robots.

Abstract: LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) integrates complementary LiDAR, camera, and IMU measurements to achieve robust state estimation. However, most existing methods assume a fixed relative pose and accurate time synchronization between sensors. Toward modular and heterogeneous robotic systems, this paper presents FREE-LIVO, a tightly coupled odometry method that requires neither a rigid LiDAR-camera rig nor LiDAR-camera time synchronization. The proposed method uses a pretrained image feature matcher to establish correspondences between a camera image and a dense LiDAR intensity image generated from a single LiDAR scan using a generative model. From the resulting 3D point-to-pixel correspondences, we construct reprojection factors that directly constrain LiDAR and camera poses at different acquisition times. These factors are jointly optimized in a single factor graph together with constraints from point cloud registration, visual feature tracking, and the IMU measurements associated with each sensor. On six sequences from the public M3DGR dataset, FREE-LIVO achieves an average absolute trajectory error (ATE) RMSE of 0.45 m without provided LiDAR-camera extrinsic parameters and exhibits minimal accuracy degradation under time synchronization errors of up to 0.5 s. Furthermore, experiments with the LiDAR and camera mounted on separate robots demonstrate that the method can jointly estimate the trajectories of independently moving sensors.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达-惯性-视觉里程计（LIVO）融合了激光雷达、相机和惯性测量单元（IMU）的互补测量信息，以实现鲁棒的状态估计。然而，现有的大多数方法假设传感器之间具有固定的相对位姿和精确的时间同步。面向模块化及异构机器人系统，本文提出了FREE-LIVO，一种紧耦合的里程计方法，该方法既不需要刚性的激光雷达-相机刚性结构，也不需要激光雷达-相机时间同步。所提出的方法利用预训练的图像特征匹配器，在相机图像与由单次激光雷达扫描通过生成模型生成的密集激光雷达强度图像之间建立对应关系。根据所得的3D点与像素的对应关系，我们构建了重投影因子，直接约束不同采集时刻的激光雷达与相机位姿。这些因子与点云配准、视觉特征跟踪以及各传感器相关联的IMU测量值的约束一起，在单个因子图中进行联合优化。在公开的M3DGR数据集的六个序列上，FREE-LIVO在未提供激光雷达-相机外参的情况下，实现了0.45米的平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）均方根误差（RMSE），并且在时间同步误差高达0.5秒的情况下，精度退化极小。此外，将激光雷达和相机分别安装在独立机器人上的实验表明，该方法能够联合估计独立运动传感器的轨迹。

Authors: Reon Tabata, Kenji Koide, Shuji Oishi, Taku Okawara, Mizuho Aoki, Aoki Takanose, Masashi Yokozuka, Jun Miura

Closed-Loop Physics-Based Manipulation Evaluation at a Commodity Price: What 4.4 L4 GPU hours at $3.50 Buys You Manipulation

low-cost evaluation action chunking contact-rich manipulation reproducible harness negative result

简要说明：本文提出了一种在商品GPU上进行接触丰富机器人操作策略评估的低成本、可复现的评估工具，并报告了在稀疏数据下动作分块的负面结果：分块预测失败，而单步策略成功。

TLDR: This paper presents a low-cost, reproducible evaluation harness for contact-rich robotic manipulation policies on commodity GPUs, and reports a negative result on action chunking with sparse data, showing that chunked predictions fail while single-step policies succeed.

Abstract: Running evaluations of contact-rich robotic manipulation at statistical scale has largely been possible only at well-resourced labs, highlighting the need for affordable and efficient options for broader audiences. We present a reproducible evaluation harness wrapper based on a previous study at 200-rollout scale on serverless commodity GPUs, at a cost of approximately $3.50 USD and 38 minutes of wall-clock per replication (4.4 L4-GPU-hours across eight parallel shards). Using the harness, we report a partially controlled negative result on action chunking with sparse data: three independently trained chunked checkpoints produce zero genuine successes across 780 rollouts, while three single-step checkpoints range from 2.6% to 11.8% success rate. A per-step-replanning control partially isolates chunk prediction, rather than open-loop chunk execution as the mechanism, with the failure localized to the training formulation and multi-step prediction. This work further democratizes physics-based policy development and evaluation through our reusable harness.

摘要（中文）：在统计规模上对接触丰富的机器人操作进行评估，此前基本上只有资源充足的实验室才能实现，这凸显了为广大受众提供经济高效方案的迫切需求。我们基于先前一项在无服务器商用GPU上进行的200次 rollout 规模研究，提出了一种可复现的评估测试框架封装，每次复现的成本约为3.50美元，墙钟时间为38分钟（在八个并行分片上总计4.4个L4-GPU小时）。利用该测试框架，我们报告了一个在稀疏数据下进行动作分块的部分受控阴性结果：三个独立训练的分块检查点在780次 rollout 中未产生任何真正的成功案例，而三个单步检查点的成功率介于2.6%至11.8%之间。通过逐步重新规划的控制实验，我们部分地将机制归因于分块预测本身，而非开环分块执行，并进一步将失败定位到训练公式和多步预测环节。这项工作通过我们可复用的测试框架，进一步推动了基于物理的策略开发与评估的普及化。

Authors: Rohun Kshirsagar, Diana Rypkema

Kinematic Hypothesis Context: Embodiment-Conditioned Learned Video Coding for Bandwidth-Limited Robot Policy Uplinks Other

learned video coding kinematic context robot policy uplink bandwidth-limited closed-loop manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种运动学假设上下文，用于学习视频编码，利用机器人关节状态和相机标定为接收端提供零速率条件，显著降低码率并提高远程机器人策略上行链路的闭环策略成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a kinematic hypothesis context for learned video coding, which uses robot joint states and camera calibration to provide zero-rate conditioning for the receiver, significantly reducing bitrate and improving closed-loop policy success rates for remote robot policy uplinks.

Abstract: Robots increasingly run large vision-language-action policies on remote servers, making the camera uplink the bottleneck. Existing video codecs spend bits on content the receiver could predict: the robot's own motion. We introduce the kinematic hypothesis context, a zero-rate conditioning signal that both ends build from joint states, the robot model and the camera calibration. Ego-motion homographies, per-link robot reprojections, an end-effector plane and a background memory warp the previous reconstruction into hypotheses that condition a learned video codec. We prove that history-only and global-pose conditioning with a limited receptive field cannot access this information under large motion, and that coding gains become task gains at the policy's success cliff. On LIBERO, the context saves 23.9% bit rate over a capacity-matched history-conditioned codec and 40-56% over x264, x265 and SVT-AV1, and needs 23.2% fewer bits than DCVC-RT at equal policy action deviation; trained to lower rates, it matches DCVC-RT in PSNR. In closed loop at equal rate, OpenVLA-OFT success nearly doubles from 22.8% to 43.1% at 6 kbps (72.6% with lower-rate training, 23.6 points above DCVC-RT), pi_0.5 success rises from 55.5% to 77.4%, and the gain grows under packet loss. The context transfers across three codec hosts and to real robot data.

摘要（中文）：机器人越来越多地在远程服务器上运行大型视觉-语言-动作策略，这使得相机上行链路成为瓶颈。现有视频编解码器将比特耗费在接收端本可预测的内容上——即机器人自身的运动。我们引入了运动学假设上下文（kinematic hypothesis context），这是一种零码率条件信号，由两端根据关节状态、机器人模型和相机标定共同构建。自运动单应矩阵、各连杆机器人重投影、末端执行器平面和背景记忆将先前重建结果扭曲为假设，用于条件化学习型视频编解码器。我们证明，在有限感受野下，仅基于历史信息和全局位姿的条件化在较大运动场景中无法获取该信息，并且编码增益在策略的成功临界点处转化为任务增益。在LIBERO基准上，该上下文相比容量匹配的历史条件化编解码器节省23.9%的码率，相比x264、x265和SVT-AV1节省40%-56%的码率，并且在同等策略动作偏差下比DCVC-RT少需23.2%的比特；在较低码率训练下，其PSNR与DCVC-RT相当。在等码率闭环测试中，OpenVLA-OFT在6 kbps下的成功率从22.8%提升至43.1%，几乎翻倍（在低码率训练下达到72.6%，高出DCVC-RT 23.6个百分点），pi_0.5的成功率从55.5%提升至77.4%，并且在丢包情况下增益进一步增大。该上下文可迁移至三种编解码器宿主及真实机器人数据。

Authors: Yuze Lu

Dynamic Watermarking and Action-Conditioned Latent Dynamics for Secure Vision-Based Controllers Manipulation

replay attack detection dynamic watermarking latent dynamics network vision-based control reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于自适应动态水印和动作条件潜动力学网络的视觉控制器重放攻击检测框架，并在UR5机械臂操作任务上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes an adaptive dynamic-watermarking framework with an action-conditioned latent dynamics network to detect replay attacks in vision-based control systems, evaluated on a UR5 manipulation task.

Abstract: Replay attacks are difficult to detect in vision-based control systems because previously recorded observations can remain plausible while the physical system follows a different trajectory. This paper develops an adaptive dynamic-watermarking framework for detecting replay attacks against vision-based controllers. A private Gaussian watermark is added to the nominal control input, and a control input-conditioned latent dynamics network (LDN) predicts the corresponding evolution in a compact latent space learned from image observations. Attack evidence is obtained from the discrepancy between the predicted latent response and the latent representation of the received image observation. A reinforcement learning policy adjusts the watermark covariance using the latent state and detector confidence, thereby balancing attack detectability, watermark energy, and control distortion. A Lagrangian penalty on task-specific safety costs is included during training to limit the adverse effect of the excitation. The framework is evaluated on a vision-guided UR5 manipulation task in which the robot reaches a target while avoiding a moving human arm under nominal and replay-attacked observations.

摘要（中文）：重放攻击在基于视觉的控制系统中难以检测，因为先前记录的观测数据在物理系统沿不同轨迹运行时仍可能保持合理。本文开发了一种自适应动态水印框架，用于检测针对基于视觉控制器的重放攻击。在名义控制输入中添加私有高斯水印，并通过控制输入条件化的潜在动态网络（LDN）在从图像观测中学习的紧凑潜在空间中预测相应的演化过程。攻击证据来源于预测的潜在响应与接收到的图像观测的潜在表示之间的差异。强化学习策略利用潜在状态和检测器置信度调整水印协方差，从而平衡攻击可检测性、水印能量和控制失真。训练过程中加入对任务特定安全成本的拉格朗日惩罚，以限制激励带来的不利影响。该框架在视觉引导的UR5操作任务中进行了评估，在该任务中，机器人在名义观测和重放攻击观测下到达目标，同时避开移动的人手臂。

Authors: Aditya Parameshwaran, Navid Aftabi, Abhishek Hanchate, Satish T. S. Bukkapatnam, Dan Li, Yue Wang

An Ordering Optimization for Fruit-Vegetable in High-Density Environment based on Genetic Algorithm Manipulation

robotic harvesting genetic algorithm harvest ordering RGB-D localization waypoint-based motion

简要说明：本文提出了一种机器人采摘方法，利用遗传算法优化密集环境中的水果采摘顺序，结合RGB-D定位和路点运动，并在实验室和田间进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper presents a robotic harvesting method that uses a genetic algorithm to optimize fruit-picking sequences in dense environments, combining RGB-D localization and waypoint-based motion, and evaluates it in lab and field tests.

Abstract: This paper presents a robotic harvesting method that combines RGB-D fruit localization, GA-based harvest ordering, and waypoint-based robot motion in dense and unstructured crop environments. The global RGB-D camera provides 3D fruit positions for ordering, while the end-effector-mounted camera provides close-range observation during execution. The GA determines the harvesting sequence, and static or dynamic waypoints define the intermediate robot motion. The method was evaluated in a controlled laboratory testbed and in four-, five-, and six-fruit field conditions. GA solutions were compared with exhaustive enumeration, and both waypoint offsets were examined by parameter sensitivity analysis. Continuous execution reduced unnecessary Home-return motion, while the dynamic waypoint changed with the remaining fruit distribution without changing the GA sequence. In the field evaluation, the dynamic-waypoint continuous strategy produced 40 collision events and a 70.7% target-approach success rate, compared with 55 collision events and 65.3% for the static-waypoint continuous strategy.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种在密集且非结构化的作物环境中，结合RGB-D果实定位、基于遗传算法的采摘排序以及基于航路点的机器人运动的机器人采摘方法。全局RGB-D相机提供用于排序的三维果实位置，而末端执行器上安装的相机则在执行过程中提供近距离观测。遗传算法确定采摘顺序，静态或动态航路点定义机器人的中间运动路径。该方法在受控的实验室测试平台以及四果、五果和六果的田间条件下进行了评估。将遗传算法求解结果与穷举法进行了比较，并通过参数敏感性分析检验了两种航路点偏移量。连续执行减少了不必要的回Home运动，而动态航路点随剩余果实分布变化，但不改变遗传算法排序。在田间评估中，动态航路点连续策略产生了40次碰撞事件，目标接近成功率为70.7%，而静态航路点连续策略则产生55次碰撞事件，成功率为65.3%。

Authors: Jaehwi Seol, Jeonghyeon Pak, Hyoung Il Son

Efficient Diffusion Policy Fine Tuning with Latent Noise Representation Bridging RLRobot

diffusion policy reinforcement learning fine-tuning latent noise representation noise aliasing FineTuneRL

简要说明：本文提出了 LARBRID 算法，通过在潜噪声线性马尔可夫决策过程框架下学习表示来优化初始噪声分布，解决了扩散策略 RL 微调中的噪声混叠问题，并在机器人运动与操作任务上获得了 2-3 倍的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces LARBRID, a representation learning algorithm for fine-tuning pre-trained diffusion policies via RL, which resolves the noise aliasing problem in a Latent Noise Linear Markov Decision Process framework and achieves 2-3x performance gains on robotic locomotion and manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Pre-trained diffusion and flow policies have emerged as powerful backbones for robotics, yet adapting them to novel data via reinforcement learning (RL) remains computationally expensive, sample inefficient and lacks theoretical guarantees. Prior approaches that fine-tune the initial noise bypass costly backpropagation through time but struggle with the "noise aliasing" problem: there does not exista natural link between the noise space value and the action space value. This paper resolves these challenges by introducing the Latent Noise Linear Markov Decision Process (LNL-MDP). We derive the Bridge Equation for LNL-MDPs which eliminates the noise aliasing problem by aligning values with a shared representation between the noise and the action space. Furthermore, our LNL-MDP fine tuning framework falls under the FineTuneRL theory with near-optimal guarantee. Leveraging these insights, we propose Latent Representation Bridging for Diffusion (LARBRID), an algorithm that efficiently learns the representation to optimize the initial distribution that steers the pre-trained model to act optimally in the environment. It yields up to 2-3$\times$ performance increases on challenging control problems across a diverse suite of robotic locomotion and manipulation tasks. Code can be found at: github.com/Maincode-Research/LARBRID.git.

摘要（中文）：预训练的扩散与流策略已成为机器人领域强大的主干模型，然而通过强化学习（RL）将其适应于新数据仍面临计算开销大、样本效率低且缺乏理论保证的问题。此前通过微调初始噪声来规避耗时的时间反向传播的方法，却受制于“噪声混叠”问题：噪声空间中的取值与动作空间中的取值之间并不存在自然的对应关系。本文通过引入潜在噪声线性马尔可夫决策过程（LNL-MDP）解决了上述挑战。我们推导出LNL-MDP的桥接方程，通过在噪声空间与动作空间之间建立共享表示来对齐取值，从而消除了噪声混叠问题。此外，我们的LNL-MDP微调框架属于FineTuneRL理论范畴，并具有近最优保证。基于这些洞见，我们提出了用于扩散模型的潜在表示桥接算法（LARBRID），该算法高效地学习表示以优化初始分布，从而引导预训练模型在环境中接近最优地行动。在涵盖多种机器人运动与操作任务的挑战性控制问题上，该算法带来了高达2-3倍的性能提升。代码见：github.com/Maincode-Research/LARBRID.git。

Authors: Yuanchu Liang, Yue Yang, An-Chi He, Hanna Kurniawati

VREgo: Consumer VR Headsets for Learning Robot Manipulation from Egocentric Demonstrations Manipulation

egocentric demonstrations VR headset robot manipulation learning from demonstration simulation

简要说明：VREgo利用消费级VR头显（PICO 4 Ultra）录制的示教来训练机器人操作策略，改进HumanEgo的预处理，并在仿真中评估桌面任务。在立方体放置任务中与Project Aria性能相当，通过规则执行增强在两阶段堆叠任务中取得高成功率。

TLDR: VREgo trains robot manipulation policies from demonstrations recorded using consumer VR headsets (PICO 4 Ultra), adapting HumanEgo's preprocessing and evaluating in simulation on tabletop tasks. It shows comparable performance to Project Aria in cube placement and achieves high success with rule-based execution enhancements in a two-stage stacking task.

Abstract: VREgo trains manipulation policies from demonstrations recorded on consumer VR headsets; we instantiate it with EgoKit on one such headset, the PICO 4 Ultra. On-device head and hand tracking and stereo object localisation allow the operator to begin a demonstration at the table. We adapt HumanEgo's preprocessing to estimate grasp thresholds per recording, update object positions after release, and propagate segmentation masks between keyframes. We evaluate policies in simulation on two tabletop tasks recorded by one operator. For cube placement, we compare PICO and Project Aria recordings of the same 41 layouts. With 40 training demonstrations, the PICO policies placed the cube on the tray in 67, 74, and 60 of 100 evaluation layouts across three training seeds. The corresponding Aria results were 73, 78, and 0. For a two-stage stacking task recorded with the PICO alone, the baseline placed the block on the tray in 94 of 100 layouts and met the end-of-episode criterion for both placements in two. In one diagnostic episode, repeated replanning deferred release beyond the eight executed steps. Demonstration replays also showed that the open gripper could displace the cube before grasping it. After adapting the training trajectories and adding task-specific execution rules that use simulator object positions, the system met both placement criteria in 93.8% of episodes across four evaluation noise seeds. The same 100 layouts informed rule development and evaluation. VREgo is available at https://vrego.chuange.org/.

摘要（中文）：VREgo利用消费者VR头显记录的演示来训练操控策略；我们通过EgoKit在PICO 4 Ultra这一头显上实例化该系统。设备上的头部和手部追踪以及立体物体定位使操作员能够在桌边开始演示。我们改进了HumanEgo的预处理流程，以逐次记录估计抓取阈值，在释放后更新物体位置，并在关键帧之间传播分割掩码。我们在模拟环境中针对由一名操作员记录的两项桌面任务评估了策略。对于立方体放置任务，我们比较了同一41种布局下PICO和Project Aria的记录结果。在使用40个训练演示的情况下，PICO策略在三种训练种子下分别于100个评估布局中的67、74和60个布局中成功将立方体放置在托盘中。对应的Aria结果分别为73、78和0。对于仅使用PICO记录的两阶段堆叠任务，基线方法在100个布局中的94个中成功将积木放置在托盘中，并在两个布局中满足两个放置阶段的回合结束标准。在一个诊断性回合中，重复的重新规划将释放推迟到了执行的八个步骤之外。演示回放还显示，开放夹爪在抓取前可能移动立方体。在调整训练轨迹并添加利用模拟器物体位置的特定任务执行规则后，系统在四种评估噪声种子下于93.8%的回合中满足了两个放置标准。相同的100种布局用于规则开发和评估。VREgo可在https://vrego.chuange.org/获取。

Authors: Liuchuan Yu

CRISP: Constraint-Resolved Interactions between Subsystems for Predictive Whole-Body Cooperation HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid robot whole-body control cooperative manipulation nonlinear model predictive control interaction wrenches

简要说明：CRISP 是一种用于人形机器人的分层控制框架，将全身动力学分解为相互连接的子系统，并通过 NMPC 联合优化手臂力矩、地面反作用力和交互力，以实现双臂协同操作，已在 G1 人形机器人上通过仿真和硬件实验验证。

TLDR: CRISP is a layered control framework for humanoid robots that decomposes the whole-body dynamics into interconnected subsystems and uses NMPC to jointly optimize arm torques, ground reaction forces, and interaction wrenches for cooperative dual-arm manipulation, validated on a G1 humanoid in simulation and hardware.

Abstract: This paper presents a layered control framework that recasts high-dimensional system dynamics as a composition of dynamically interconnected subsystems, with dynamic dual-arm manipulation on the humanoid serving as a representative application. The humanoid is decomposed into a single rigid body (SRB) representing the torso and floating-base dynamic models representing the articulated arms and lower-body. The rigid connections between arm and torso and the closed kinematic chain formed between the end-effectors during cooperative manipulation are represented as holonomic constraints. The corresponding Lagrange multipliers parametrize the interaction wrenches transmitted at the shoulders and between the end-effectors. The high-level nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) jointly optimizes the subsystem state trajectories, arm torques, ground reaction forces (GRFs), and interaction wrenches, enabling online wrench design and optimization while preserving the dynamic coupling among the independently modeled subsystems. The optimized arm torques are applied directly for cooperative dual-arm manipulation, whereas the prescribed GRFs are mapped to lower-body joint torque for whole-body coordination. We validate the proposed framework through numerical simulations and hardware experiments on a G1 humanoid robot. The results demonstrate optimal interaction wrenches consistent with simulated contact measurement, cooperative dual-arm trajectory tracking, and stable whole-body coordination while executing the NMPC in online manner.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种分层控制框架，将高维系统动力学重构为动态互联子系统的组合，并以人形机器人上的动态双臂操作为代表性应用。人形机器人被分解为表示躯干的单刚体模型以及表示关节臂和下半身的浮基动力学模型。手臂与躯干之间的刚性连接，以及协作操作过程中末端执行器之间形成的闭式运动链，均以完整约束的形式加以描述。相应的拉格朗日乘子参数化表征了肩部及末端执行器之间传递的交互力旋量。高层非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）联合优化子系统状态轨迹、手臂力矩、地面反作用力（GRFs）及交互力旋量，从而在保持各独立建模子系统间动态耦合的同时，实现在线力旋量设计与优化。优化后的手臂力矩直接用于协作双臂操作，而预定的地面反作用力则映射至下半身关节力矩以实现全身协调。我们通过数值仿真及在G1人形机器人上的硬件实验对所提出的框架进行了验证。结果表明，该框架能够获得与仿真接触测量一致的优化交互力旋量，实现协作双臂轨迹跟踪，并在在线执行NMPC的同时保持稳定的全身协调。

Authors: Dario Valenzuela, Jeeseop Kim

An Empirical Study of Reinforcement Learning for Keypoint Positioning of Deformable Linear Objects Manipulation

Deformable linear objects Reinforcement learning Sim-to-real transfer Proximal Policy Optimization Keypoint positioning

简要说明：本文研究了平面操作中可变形线性物体关键点定位的强化学习方法，比较了不同PPO训练栈，并展示了通过域随机化训练的策略在无微调情况下成功实现仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: This paper investigates reinforcement learning for keypoint positioning of deformable linear objects in planar manipulation, comparing PPO training stacks and demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of policies trained with domain randomization to physical trials.

Abstract: Deformable linear object (DLO) manipulation is challenging because high-dimensional configurations, nonlinear contact dynamics, and diverse material and geometric properties produce a broad range of object responses that are both difficult to model and data-intensive to learn. This work studies reinforcement learning for planar manipulation of a one-end-grasped DLO, focusing on training efficiency, observation design, robustness, and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. We compare three Proximal Policy Optimization training stacks and find that the GPU-parallel MuJoCo Playground stack enables faster convergence and more consistent performance than CPU-based alternatives under the same wall-clock budget. Relative keypoint observations and an asymmetric actor-critic formulation further improve learning efficiency. Policies trained with observation noise, delay, domain randomization, and disturbances achieve simulation success rates of 96.4% for single-point tracking, 98.0% for disturbance recovery, and 88.8% for two-point tracking. Using markerless RGB-D keypoint estimation, the policies transfer without real-world fine-tuning, succeeding in 9/10, 10/10, and 8/10 physical trials, respectively.

摘要（中文）：可变形线性物体（DLO）的操作因高维构型、非线性接触动力学以及多样的材料与几何属性而具有挑战性，这些因素导致物体响应范围广泛，既难以建模又需要大量数据进行学习。本研究针对一端抓持DLO的平面操作，探讨强化学习方法，重点关注训练效率、观测设计、鲁棒性及零样本模拟到现实迁移。我们比较了三种近端策略优化训练架构，发现在相同的墙钟时间预算下，基于GPU并行化的MuJoCo Playground架构比基于CPU的替代方案收敛更快、性能更为稳定。相对关键点观测与非对称演员-评论家结构进一步提升了学习效率。结合观测噪声、延迟、域随机化及干扰训练的策略，在单点跟踪、干扰恢复及两点跟踪任务中的模拟成功率分别达到96.4%、98.0%和88.8%。通过无标记RGB-D关键点估计，这些策略无需真实环境微调即可实现迁移，在物理实验中分别成功完成9/10、10/10和8/10次试验。

Authors: Vinay Rodrigues, Sara Zeynalpour, Gokhan Solak, Sebastian Hjorth, Arash Ajoudani

Adaptive Hybrid Force-Vision Control with EMG-Derived References for Deformable Bottle Manipulation Manipulation

adaptive hybrid force-vision control deformable object manipulation EMG-derived force reference robotic liquid dispensing laboratory automation

简要说明：本文提出了一种自适应混合力-视觉控制器，用于机器人操纵可变形挤压瓶，使用从人类演示中获得的EMG力参考。该控制器在液体分配精度上优于纯力控制器，并更接近人类动作。

TLDR: This paper introduces an adaptive hybrid force-vision controller for robotic manipulation of deformable squeeze bottles, using EMG-derived force references from human demonstrations. The controller outperforms a pure force controller in liquid dispensing accuracy and replicates human actions more closely.

Abstract: Robotic automation of laboratory tasks has become a growing interest to remove researchers from hazardous environments and repetitive procedures. However, even equipment as simple as squeeze bottles poses a challenging manipulation problem due to its deformability. This paper presents an adaptive hybrid vision-force controller for robotic grippers to effectively manipulate laboratory squeeze bottles to dispense liquid. This approach integrates force and vision feedback according to the interaction state, enabling effective squeezing while accounting for bottle deformation and recovery. The proposed controller is validated by comparing its performance with a pure force controller on 12 combinations of conditions consisting of 2 target dispense volumes, 2 plastic squeeze bottles, and 1 to 3 squeezes used to dispense. Human demonstrations of these operating conditions were collected using electromyography (EMG) sensing mapped to a desired grip force, which was then used as the force reference for the controllers to squeeze the bottles. Results demonstrated that the proposed adaptive hybrid vision-force controller achieved more accurate liquid dispensing with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 6.54 mL compared to a MAE of 15.92 mL from the pure force controller, while also replicating the human action recorded from the EMG signal more closely.

摘要（中文）：实验室任务的机器人自动化日益受到关注，其目的是让研究人员远离危险环境和重复性操作。然而，即使是像挤瓶这样简单的设备，由于其可变形性，也构成了颇具挑战性的操控问题。本文提出了一种自适应视觉-力混合控制器，用于机器人夹爪有效操控实验室挤瓶进行液体分配。该方法根据交互状态整合力反馈与视觉反馈，在考虑瓶子变形与回弹的同时实现有效挤压。通过将该控制器与纯力控制器在12种条件组合下进行性能对比验证，这些组合包括2种目标分配体积、2种塑料挤瓶以及1至3次挤压分配。利用肌电（EMG）传感采集人类操作演示，并将其映射为期望的握力，作为控制器挤压瓶子的力参考。结果表明，所提出的自适应视觉-力混合控制器实现了更精确的液体分配，平均绝对误差（MAE）为6.54 mL，而纯力控制器的MAE为15.92 mL，同时更贴近地复现了从肌电信号记录的人类动作。

Authors: Jeffrey Lee, Geoffrey Hanks, Evangeline Bouganim, Yue Hu

Distributed Geometric Optimization and Control of Rigid Differential-Drive Formations from Relative-Position Measurements Locomotion

formation control distributed optimization differential-drive robots relative-position measurements ROS 2 Gazebo

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于分布式优化的两层估计-控制方案，用于差分驱动机器人的刚性编队，利用相对位置测量和单个绝对位置锚点，并在仿真和实物实验中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a distributed optimization-based two-layer estimation-control scheme for rigid formations of differential-drive robots, using relative-position measurements and a single absolute position anchor, validated in simulation and with physical robots.

Abstract: Distance based formation control fixes the shape of a robot team but leaves its position and orientation unconstrained. We regulate all three for differential drive robots that have only one absolute position anchor, absolute headings, body frame relative position measurements, and communication with their neighbors. We derive a two layer estimation control scheme directly from optimization. The first half of the result is a set of graph-proximal estimators that reconstruct the centroid, the anchor vector, and the centered coordinates. Exact proximal updates reach consensus in finitely many steps, and a finite number of primal dual iterations leaves a bounded reconstruction error. The controller combines proximal centroid and orientation steps with distance gradient shape regulation, and a finite rotation removes the orientation drift caused by the shape step. A discrete Lyapunov analysis gives local exponential convergence once the estimators have converged. We validate the method in ROS 2 Gazebo and in experiments with five physical robots.

摘要（中文）：基于距离的编队控制固定了机器人团队的形状，但未约束其位置和朝向。我们针对仅拥有一个绝对位置锚点、绝对朝向、机体坐标系下相对位置测量以及能够与邻居通信的差速驱动机器人，对其位置、朝向和形状进行统一调节。我们直接从优化中推导出一种两层估计控制方案。结果的前半部分是一组图近端估计器，用于重建质心、锚点向量及中心化坐标。精确的近端更新在有限步内达成共识，且有限次的主-对偶迭代会留下有界的重建误差。控制器将近端质心和朝向步骤与距离梯度形状调节相结合，并通过有限次旋转消除由形状步骤引起的朝向漂移。离散李雅普诺夫分析表明，在估计器收敛后，系统具有局部指数收敛性。我们在ROS 2 Gazebo仿真中及使用五台实体机器人的实验中验证了该方法。

Authors: Thanacha Choopojcharoen, Erman Selim, Ramisha Anjum, Baris Fidan

Rethinking Self-Repair in Code-as-Policy Agents: What Drives Retry Success? Manipulation

code-as-policy self-repair execution feedback robot manipulation VLA

简要说明：本文研究了模拟机器人操作中代码即策略智能体的自我修复机制，发现针对失败的反馈相比重新采样或静态指导并无明显优势，且在某些需要非默认抓取的任务中甚至有害。

TLDR: This paper investigates self-repair in code-as-policy agents for simulated robot manipulation, finding that failure-specific feedback offers no clear benefit over resampling or static guidance, and that feedback can even be harmful in tasks requiring non-default grasps.

Abstract: Code-as-policy agents often use execution feedback to retry failed programs. Additional sampling and task guidance can also improve success, leaving the contribution of failure-specific feedback unclear. We study this question in simulated robot manipulation. A fixed lookup selects feedback templates using failure labels and the API variant. A frozen code model generates a fresh program after each scene reset. On the same 252 initial failures, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B recovers 85.3% within five retries, compared with 68.3% for resampling with the same retry cap. The advantage persists under fixed total-token budgets. Feedback from other episodes and fixed task guidance yield similar recovery point estimates, with no detected benefit from matching the coarse failure label. In a separate study, a fixed guided prompt used from the first attempt achieves an observed overall success rate similar to that of template-based feedback. Template-based feedback also lowers recovery on a nut-insertion task requiring a rim grasp, consistent with an incompatible center-grasp instruction. Evaluations of robot self-repair should include resampling, mismatched feedback, and concise, task-compatible static guidance as baselines.

摘要（中文）：以代码为策略的智能体常常利用执行反馈来重试失败的程序。额外的采样和任务引导也能提升成功率，这使得失败特定反馈的具体贡献变得不明确。我们在模拟机器人操作环境中研究这一问题。固定查找表根据失败标签和API变体选择反馈模板，冻结的代码模型在每次场景重置后生成新的程序。在相同的252个初始失败案例中，Qwen2.5-Coder-7B在五次重试内恢复了85.3%的成功率，而相同重试上限下的重采样方法仅为68.3%。在固定总令牌预算下，这一优势依然存在。来自其他回合的反馈和固定任务引导在恢复点估计上结果相近，且未发现匹配粗略失败标签能带来可检测的额外收益。在一项独立研究中，从首次尝试起使用固定引导提示所观察到的总体成功率与基于模板的反馈相当。在需要边缘抓取的螺母插入任务中，基于模板的反馈反而降低了恢复率，这与不兼容的中心抓取指令一致。对机器人自我修复的评估应将重采样、不匹配反馈以及简洁且任务兼容的静态引导作为基线。

Authors: Siddharth Aphale, Ayushman Singh

RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines RLRobot

reward machines vision-language model reinforcement learning non-Markovian tasks grounding

简要说明：RM-VLM 利用大语言模型从自然语言任务描述中生成奖励机，并用视觉语言模型将命题映射到图像观测，为强化学习提供密集奖励信号，在导航、操作和物体收集中优于现有基于 VLM 的奖励方法。

TLDR: RM-VLM uses an LLM to generate reward machines from natural-language task descriptions and a VLM to ground propositions in images, providing dense reward signals for RL in non-Markovian tasks, achieving higher success rates than existing VLM-based rewards in navigation, manipulation, and object collection.

Abstract: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.

摘要（中文）：奖励机器（RMs）已被提出作为强化学习（RL）中的一种奖励形式，用于捕捉信用分配依赖于历史记录的非马尔可夫任务。通过将奖励函数表示为自动机，RMs揭示了任务的时间结构，并允许在马尔可夫框架内处理此类奖励。然而，它们假设存在一个标签函数，即对观测进行命题接地（proposition-grounding）的预言机，该函数必须针对每个环境手动设计，这限制了其更广泛的应用。在本工作中，我们通过提出RM-VLM来解决这一限制，这是一种新颖的方法，其中大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言任务描述中生成RM，而视觉-语言模型（VLM）则充当标签函数，在RM引导的策略学习过程中，将RM的命题与基于图像的观测进行接地。我们利用基于VLM的价值函数估计器来评估代理朝向每个RM转移的进展，并推导出密集奖励信号。我们在三个领域上评估RM-VLM，涵盖非马尔可夫网格世界导航、机器人操作和三维物体收集。我们的实验结果表明，在所有测试领域中，RM-VLM始终比现有的基于VLM的奖励方法取得更高的任务成功率。

Authors: Roko Parac, Christos Ziakas, Leo Ardon, Alessandra Russo

MAC-v2: Long-horizon model-based value expansion from pixels WorldModel

model-based value expansion latent world model action chunking offline RL pixel-based

简要说明：MAC-v2 通过无重建的潜在世界模型和动作分块，实现了从像素进行长时程模型价值扩展，在多个视觉基准上取得了良好的离线强化学习性能。

TLDR: MAC-v2 introduces a reconstruction-free latent world model with action chunking for long-horizon model-based value expansion from pixels, achieving strong offline RL performance across visual benchmarks.

Abstract: We study whether \emph{long-horizon model-based value expansion} can serve as an effective framework in pixel-based offline reinforcement learning (RL). Long-horizon model-based value expansion from pixels is substantially harder than state-based environments, as the agent must learn both the representation and its dynamics, and errors from either can accumulate recursively over imagined trajectories. We introduce MAC-v2, which enables long-horizon model-based expansion from pixels by training a reconstruction-free latent world model with action chunking. By learning representations from prediction and control objectives, MAC-v2 does not need to encode control-irrelevant visual details that can hinder the dynamics prediction. Action chunking further mitigates the prediction error by reducing the number of recursive model predictions required for value expansion. Across diverse visual benchmarks including visual OGBench, MMBench2, Robomimic, and LIBERO-10, MAC-v2 achieves strong performance against model-free and model-based offline RL baselines. Our analyses show that long-horizon model-based value expansion is critical for the performance of MAC-v2, and that both action chunking and latent learning objectives are essential for reliable long-horizon latent imagination.

摘要（中文）：我们研究长期模型基价值扩展能否在基于像素的离线强化学习中成为一种有效框架。与基于状态的环境相比，从像素出发进行长期模型基价值扩展的难度显著更高，因为智能体必须同时学习表征及其动态变化，而两者中的任何误差都可能在想象轨迹中递归累积。我们提出了MAC-v2，该方法通过采用动作分块的免重建潜在世界模型，实现从像素出发的长期模型基扩展。通过从预测和控制目标中学习表征，MAC-v2无需编码与控制无关的视觉细节，这些细节可能妨碍动态预测。动作分块进一步通过减少价值扩展所需的递归模型预测次数来缓解预测误差。在包括视觉OGBench、MMBench2、Robomimic和LIBERO-10在内的多个视觉基准测试中，MAC-v2在基于模型和无模型的离线强化学习基线中均展现出强劲性能。我们的分析表明，长期模型基价值扩展对MAC-v2的性能至关重要，而动作分块和潜在学习目标对于可靠的长期潜在想象均不可或缺。

Authors: Kwanyoung Park, Sergey Levine

FreeOcc: Decoupling Ego-Motion for Efficient 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Continuous Flow Matching AutonomousDriving

4D occupancy forecasting world model flow matching SE(2) decoupling efficient

简要说明：FreeOcc 提出了一种轻量级连续时间世界模型，通过显式解耦自运动到动态特征空间，实现了免注意力的时序融合和物理约束的 ODE，从而高效且鲁棒地进行 4D 占用预测。

TLDR: FreeOcc introduces a lightweight continuous-time world model for 4D occupancy forecasting that decouples ego-motion into a dynamic feature space, enabling attention-free temporal fusion and physics-constrained ODEs for efficient and robust predictions.

Abstract: Current 4D occupancy world models use heavy cross-attention or deep recurrence to disentangle ego-motion from scene dynamics. This requires significant computational capacity. However, this effort is largely redundant since the ego-vehicle's intended future motion is provided by the downstream motion planner. We present FreeOcc, a lightweight continuous-time world model that introduces explicit $SE(2)$ geometric decoupling into a conditional flow-matching framework. By mathematically factoring out self-motion, we create a purely dynamic feature space. This space supports attention-free temporal fusion and allows physics-constrained ODEs to operate strictly on residual agent kinematics. To maximize deployment efficiency, FreeOcc introduces an uncertainty-aware blending mechanism. This routes well-observed voxels to a single-pass decoder, reserving the ODE solver exclusively for ambiguous, high-uncertainty regions. Requiring only 28.3M parameters-roughly 40% of comparable models-our optimal ensemble mode (FreeOcc-E) runs at 27 FPS. On nuScenes, FreeOcc achieves state-of-the-art forecasting performance with a 0.47 m Near Field Chamfer Distance (NFCD) and 32.1% mIoU. Furthermore, the model transfers zero-shot to SemanticKITTI. It also proves highly robust, retaining 92.8% of its ideal mIoU under significant sensor packet loss and timestamp jitter.

摘要（中文）：现有的4D占据世界模型使用重型交叉注意力或深度递归机制来解耦自车运动与场景动态，这需要巨大的计算能力。然而，由于下游运动规划器已提供自车预期未来运动，这一努力在很大程度上是冗余的。我们提出FreeOcc，一种轻量级连续时间世界模型，将显式$SE(2)$几何解耦引入条件流匹配框架。通过数学上分解自运动，我们创建了一个纯动态特征空间。该空间支持免注意力的时间融合，并允许物理约束的常微分方程严格作用于残差智能体运动学。为最大化部署效率，FreeOcc引入了一种基于不确定性感知的融合机制，将观测良好的体素路由到单次解码器，而将常微分方程求解器仅保留给模糊、高不确定性的区域。仅需2830万参数——约为同类模型的40%——我们的最优集成模式（FreeOcc-E）即可在27 FPS下运行。在nuScenes上，FreeOcc实现了最先进的预测性能，近场倒角距离（NFCD）为0.47 m，mIoU为32.1%。此外，该模型可零样本迁移至SemanticKITTI。它还具有很强的鲁棒性，在严重的传感器数据包丢失和时间戳抖动情况下，仍能保持理想mIoU的92.8%。

Authors: Zeping Zhang, Zhuoya Zhao, Samy Metari, Robert Laganière

PlayGen2: Learning Real-Time Playable Worlds with Explicit 3D State WorldModel

real-time interactive world model 3D state neural rendering action-conditioned entity dynamics Doom

简要说明：PlayGen2 是一个实时的交互式世界模型，将学习的 3D 状态演化与神经渲染分离，从而在可玩的 Doom 环境中实现持久的空间结构和连贯的交互。

TLDR: PlayGen2 is a real-time interactive world model that separates learned 3D state evolution from neural rendering, enabling persistent spatial structure and coherent interactions in a playable Doom environment.

Abstract: Building a playable world requires more than generating plausible video: it demands responsive control, persistent spatial structure, and coherent interactions with dynamic entities. Using generated frames as the sole recurrent world representation ties these requirements to view-dependent appearance synthesis, making it difficult to maintain long-term spatial and temporal consistency in generation and interaction. We present PlayGen2, a real-time interactive world model that separates learned 3D state evolution from neural rendering. PlayGen2 maintains a persistent world memory comprising static geometry represented by a volumetric occupancy grid and identity-indexed 3D states for the player and other entities. Within a fixed-size local region, its world-state model jointly learns action-conditioned entity dynamics, geometry completion, and entity discovery, committing updates to a persistent world memory. A separate neural renderer synthesizes first-person observations from depth and semantic projections of the world state, without feeding generated images back into state prediction. Using Doom as a testbed, we demonstrate that the model successfully learns world dynamics including geometry-aware player motion and player--NPC interactions. The framework is computationally efficient, enabling the complete simulation and rendering pipeline to achieve approximately 160ms backend latency on a MacBook Pro with an M4 Pro chip. Beyond single-player interaction, we demonstrate zero-shot deployment on unseen Doom maps, multiplayer interaction through the composition of single-player models, and programmable gameplay through rule-based state interventions. These capabilities demonstrate the transferability and extensibility of the learned game-world model. Code and pretrained model weights are publicly available.

摘要（中文）：构建一个可游玩的游戏世界，其要求远不止于生成逼真的视频：它还需要响应式控制、持续存在的空间结构，以及与动态实体之间连贯的交互。若将生成的帧作为唯一的循环世界表征，则会将上述需求与视角相关的外观合成绑定在一起，使得在生成和交互过程中难以维持长期的空间与时间一致性。为此，我们提出了PlayGen2，一个实时交互式世界模型，它将学习到的3D状态演化与神经渲染解耦。PlayGen2维护一个持久化的世界记忆，其中包含由体素占用网格表示的静态几何结构，以及针对玩家和其他实体的、以身份为索引的3D状态。在固定大小的局部区域内，其世界状态模型联合学习动作条件化的实体动力学、几何补全和实体发现，并将更新提交至持久化世界记忆。一个独立的神经渲染器从世界状态的深度投影和语义投影中合成第一人称观察，而不会将生成的图像反馈至状态预测。以《毁灭战士》为测试平台，我们证明了该模型能够成功学习世界动态，包括几何感知的玩家运动和玩家与NPC之间的交互。该框架计算高效，在搭载M4 Pro芯片的MacBook Pro上，完整的模拟与渲染流程可实现约160毫秒的后端延迟。除单人交互外，我们还展示了在未见过的《毁灭战士》地图上的零样本部署、通过组合单玩家模型实现的多人交互，以及基于规则的状态干预实现的可编程玩法。这些能力证明了所学游戏世界模型的可迁移性与可扩展性。代码与预训练模型权重均已公开。

Authors: Jihai Zhang, Yuhan Zhou, Junyou Li, Deheng Ye, Qi Dou, Yu Cheng

Towards Real-Time Full-Waveform LiDAR Transformers via Intensity-Guided Token Reduction and Physics-Aware Augmentation AutonomousDriving

full-waveform LiDAR token reduction data augmentation real-time perception autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了FWL-ToPM，一种用于全波形LiDAR Transformer的令牌剪枝与合并机制，以及FWLAug，一种物理感知的数据增强框架，在Ghost-FWL基准上实现了超过8倍的加速和显著的精度提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces FWL-ToPM, a token pruning and merging mechanism for full-waveform LiDAR Transformers, and FWLAug, a physics-aware data augmentation framework, achieving over 8x speedup and significant accuracy gains on the Ghost-FWL benchmark.

Abstract: LiDAR is a critical sensor for autonomous driving and robotics, yet it remains vulnerable to adverse conditions such as fog, rain, transparent objects, and low-reflectance surfaces. Full-waveform LiDAR (FWL) addresses these limitations by capturing the complete return waveform as a histogram, preserving rich reflection characteristics including multi-path echoes and weak signals. While recent Transformer-based approaches have demonstrated promise on FWL data, two fundamental bottlenecks remain: high computational cost from redundant tokens in low-intensity background regions, and limited generalization due to scarce annotated training data. We address both bottlenecks by exploiting the physical structure inherent to FWL data. First, we propose FWL-ToPM, a token pruning and merging mechanism that leverages intensity distributions to selectively reduce tokens while retaining critical waveform content. Second, we introduce FWLAug, a data augmentation framework designed as a regularization method that preserves waveform structure, retaining the Time-of-Flight waveform of each ray and the frustum geometry, to improve generalization to unseen scenes. Evaluated on the Ghost-FWL benchmark, FWL-ToPM achieves over 8 times speedup at real-time throughput alongside a nearly 9-point F1 gain over the prior state of the art, establishing the first real-time FWL Transformer that simultaneously improves accuracy. FWLAug further improves performance on both the standard benchmark and an out-of-distribution test set of unseen scenes. Together, these methods push FWL-based perception toward practical deployment. The code and the OOD dataset are publicly available and can be accessed via the project page: https://keio-csg.github.io/FWL-ToPM

摘要（中文）：激光雷达是自动驾驶和机器人领域的关键传感器，然而其在雾、雨、透明物体和低反射率表面等恶劣条件下仍存在脆弱性。全波形激光雷达通过将完整回波波形以直方图形式捕获，保留了包括多路径回波和微弱信号在内的丰富反射特征，从而解决了上述局限性。尽管近期基于Transformer的方法在全波形激光雷达数据上展现出了良好前景，但仍存在两个根本性瓶颈：低强度背景区域中冗余令牌导致的高计算成本，以及标注训练数据稀缺所带来的有限泛化能力。我们通过利用全波形激光雷达数据固有的物理结构来同时解决这两个瓶颈。首先，我们提出了FWL-ToPM，一种利用强度分布选择性地减少令牌同时保留关键波形内容的令牌剪枝与合并机制。其次，我们引入了FWLAug，一种作为正则化方法设计的、保持波形结构的数据增强框架，该框架保留了每条光线的飞行时间波形和视锥几何结构，以提高对未见场景的泛化能力。在Ghost-FWL基准上的评估表明，FWL-ToPM在实时吞吐量下实现了超过8倍的加速，同时相较于现有最先进方法在F1分数上提升了近9个百分点，建立了首个同时提升精度的实时全波形激光雷达Transformer。FWLAug进一步在标准基准和包含未见场景的分布外测试集上提升了性能。这两种方法共同推动了基于全波形激光雷达的感知走向实际部署。代码和分布外数据集已公开，可通过项目页面访问：https://keio-csg.github.io/FWL-ToPM

Authors: Kotaro Oishi, Kazuma Ikeda, Ryosei Hara, Ryo Yoshida, Mariko Isogawa, Kentaro Yoshioka

Wide View Synthesis from Overlapping Perspective Cameras in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Gaussian Splatting wide view synthesis autonomous driving multi-camera feed-forward

简要说明：本文提出宽视野高斯泼溅（WV-GS），一种用于自动驾驶中从多个重叠相机合成几何一致宽视野的前馈框架，解决了边缘拉伸和光度不一致等挑战，并提出了WideDrive基准。

TLDR: This paper introduces Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS), a feed-forward framework for synthesizing geometrically consistent wide views from multiple overlapping cameras in autonomous driving, addressing challenges like peripheral stretching and photometric inconsistencies, and proposes the WideDrive benchmark.

Abstract: Multi-perspective-camera systems are widely adopted since they provide broad visual coverage for autonomous driving, motivating the synthesis of a unified wide view from spatially separated observations. In this work, we formulate wide view synthesis (WVS), which aims to synthesize a geometrically consistent wide view at a specified virtual viewpoint from multiple perspective cameras. Unlike conventional image stitching, WVS requires reasoning about 3D geometry and visibility to handle depth-dependent parallax and occlusions arising from spatially separated camera centers. While vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity view synthesis, its reliance on per-scene optimization limits its applicability to driving scenes. Furthermore, WVS introduces additional challenges, *e.g.*, peripheral stretching under perspective projection and photometric inconsistencies across cameras. To address these challenges, we propose **Wide-View Gaussian Splatting (WV-GS)**, a feed-forward Gaussian-splatting framework that synthesizes wide views without per-scene optimization. Specifically, we introduce Piecewise Perspective Rendering (PPR) to mitigate peripheral stretching through local perspective projections sharing a common camera center, and Spatial Affine Photometric Modeling (SAPM) to account for camera-dependent photometric variations during training. We further introduce **WideDrive**, a synthetic benchmark providing dense ground-truth wide views and adapt a LiDAR-projected sparse-reference protocol to real-world datasets. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of WV-GS for WVS. Dataset and code will be publicly released.

摘要（中文）：多视角相机系统因能为自动驾驶提供广阔的视觉覆盖而被广泛采用，这促使研究人员探索如何将空间上分离的观测合成为统一的全景视图。在本工作中，我们提出了广角视图合成（WVS）任务，旨在从多个透视相机在指定虚拟视点处合成几何一致的广角视图。与传统图像拼接不同，WVS需要对三维几何和可见性进行推理，以处理由空间分离的相机中心引起的深度相关视差和遮挡问题。尽管原始的三维高斯溅射（3DGS）技术能够实现高保真的视图合成，但其依赖逐场景优化，限制了其在驾驶场景中的应用。此外，WVS还引入了额外的挑战，例如透视投影下的边缘拉伸以及相机间的光度不一致性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了**广角视图高斯溅射（WV-GS）**，一种无需逐场景优化的前馈式高斯溅射框架，可直接合成广角视图。具体而言，我们引入了分段透视渲染（PPR），通过共享同一相机中心的局部透视投影来缓解边缘拉伸问题；同时引入空间仿射光度建模（SAPM），在训练过程中对相机依赖的光度变化进行建模。我们还进一步构建了**WideDrive**，一个提供稠密真值广角视图的合成基准，并将基于LiDAR投影的稀疏参考协议适配到真实世界数据集。在多个数据集上的大量实验证明了WV-GS在WVS任务中的有效性。数据集和代码将公开发布。

Authors: Kaixuan Zhang, Zhipeng Xiong, Minxian Li, Mingwu Ren, Xiatian Zhu

Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models static collapse motion-guided contrastive regularization optical flow visual control

简要说明：本文识别了潜在世界模型中的静态崩溃问题（背景内容主导表示），并提出利用光流相似性的运动引导对比正则化，以提升操作基准上的规划性能。

TLDR: This paper identifies static collapse in latent world models where background content dominates representations, and proposes motion-guided contrastive regularization using optical-flow similarities to improve planning performance on manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: JEPA-style world models learn action-conditioned latent dynamics without reconstructing observations, but distributional regularization alone does not ensure that their representations preserve information needed for control. We identify static collapse, a failure mode in which the encoder preserves episode-specific static content while suppressing manipulation-relevant state changes. Because static content is temporally predictable yet diverse across episodes, this failure can persist despite regularizers such as SIGReg. A controlled study on OGBench-Cube shows that introducing randomized backgrounds substantially degrades planning performance while leaving the underlying manipulation task unchanged. To address this problem, we propose motion-guided contrastive regularization. Our approach compares predicted latent transitions with transitions to candidate observations from the same episode, reducing the usefulness of static background identity for distinguishing action outcomes. Optical-flow similarities provide soft contrastive targets, allowing candidates with similar motion to receive similar supervision. Combined with latent prediction and SIGReg, our objective encourages representations to preserve within-episode state distinctions and similarities between related transitions. Our method improves planning success over LeWorldModel (LeWM) from 52% to 78% on OGBench-Cube with randomized backgrounds and from 14% to 54% on LIBERO-Object, while maintaining comparable performance on four other visual-control benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：JEPA风格的世界模型在不重建观测的情况下学习基于动作的潜在动力学，但仅靠分布正则化并不能确保其表示保留控制所需的信息。我们识别出一种称为“静态坍缩”（static collapse）的失效模式，即编码器保留每个幕（episode）特有的静态内容，同时抑制与操作相关的状态变化。由于静态内容在时间上可预测但跨幕具有多样性，这种失效即使在SIGReg等正则化方法下仍可能持续存在。在OGBench-Cube上进行的受控研究表明，引入随机背景会显著降低规划性能，而底层操作任务本身并未改变。为解决该问题，我们提出基于运动引导的对比正则化方法。该方法将预测的潜在转移与同一幕中候选观测的转移进行比较，从而降低静态背景身份在区分动作结果方面的有效性。光流相似性提供软对比目标，使具有相似运动的候选样本获得相似的监督信号。结合潜在预测与SIGReg，我们的目标函数鼓励表示保留幕内状态区分能力以及相关转移之间的相似性。我们的方法将LeWorldModel（LeWM）在OGBench-Cube随机背景下的规划成功率从52%提升至78%，在LIBERO-Object上从14%提升至54%，同时在另外四个视觉控制基准上保持相当的性能。

Authors: Yiwen Chen, Qiqi Hou, Jisoo Jeong, Yinhao Zhu, Huaizu Jiang, Amir Said

VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception Other

multi-modal simulator physical sensor models robot perception event cameras LiDAR

简要说明：VisionSIM 是一个物理基础的多模态模拟器，通过建模事件相机、SPAD、iToF/dToF、热成像和 LiDAR 等传感器的原始测量过程，再现真实故障模式，为机器人感知提供跨模态对比平台。

TLDR: VisionSIM is a physically grounded multi-modal simulator that models the raw measurement process for diverse sensors (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, thermal, LiDAR) to reproduce realistic failure modes and enable cross-modality comparison for robot perception.

Abstract: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.

摘要（中文）：机器人感知越来越依赖于将相机与新兴模态（事件相机、SPAD、iToF/dToF和热成像）相结合的异构传感器套件。然而，现有的模拟器将这些传感器理想化，掩盖了限制实际部署的关键模态特定失效模式。我们提出了VisionSIM，一个统一的、基于物理的仿真平台，通过建模多种传统和新兴模态的原始物理测量过程，将传感器真实性提升为优先关注的问题。我们提供对物理传感器参数的细粒度控制，再现了通用模拟器所忽视的失效模式：LiDAR的堆积和眩光；iToF的相位包裹、饱和及运动伪影；事件相机的 refractory drops；以及热相机的历史依赖发射。这使得在相同场景和轨迹上进行原理性的跨模态比较成为可能。我们发布了该平台以及一个包含同步原始测量和丰富地面真值标注的大型室内数据集。

Authors: Sacha Jungerman, Kaustubh Sadekar, Avery Gump, Sriram Narayanan, Shantanu Gupta, Bhuyashi Deka, Srinivasa Narasimhan, Atul Ingle, Mohit Gupta

An Integrated Open-Source Stack for Vision-Based Autonomous Navigation of Wheeled Rovers Other

autonomous navigation wheeled rover ROS 2 YOLOv8n RGB-D SLAM

简要说明：本文介绍了一个用于轮式漫游车视觉自主导航的开源ROS 2堆栈，集成了YOLOv8n检测、RGB-D SLAM和行为树任务管理，以完成箭头跟随和自主返回任务。

TLDR: This paper presents an open-source ROS 2 stack for vision-based autonomous navigation of wheeled rovers, integrating YOLOv8n detection, RGB-D SLAM, and behavior-tree mission management for arrow-following and autonomous return tasks.

Abstract: Vision-based rover autonomy requires integrating perception, localization, planning and platform-specific control under limited sensing and computing resources. We present an open-source ROS 2 stack for following directional arrows, reaching a terminal cone and returning autonomously to the start. It connects YOLOv8n detection and geometric direction, range and bearing estimation with RGB-D SLAM, wheel-inertial state estimation, kinematics-aware planning, behavior-tree mission management and STM32 actuation. Standard interfaces separate reusable autonomy from the hardware layer; a proportional path-following plugin supports low-speed rover motion. Public resources include software, configuration, a labeled dataset, trained weights and evaluation logs. On 478 held-out images, the detector achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.720 under the Ultralytics evaluator and outperforms a classical OpenCV baseline under a shared evaluation protocol. The reported perception latency is 25 ms on a Jetson Orin NX. Three missions, one indoor and two outdoor, demonstrate marker-guided navigation and autonomous return without operator motion commands or reported collisions. Field results document integration failures and corrective choices; repeated instrumented trials remain necessary to quantify physical navigation errors and reliability.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的漫游车自主运行需要在有限的感知和计算资源下，整合感知、定位、规划以及平台特定的控制功能。我们提出了一套开源ROS 2软件栈，用于实现跟随方向箭头、抵达终端锥桶并自主返回起点的功能。该系统将YOLOv8n目标检测与几何方向、距离和方位估计相结合，并集成RGB-D SLAM、轮式惯性状态估计、考虑运动学约束的规划、行为树任务管理以及STM32执行控制。标准接口将可复用的自主功能与硬件层分离；比例路径跟踪插件支持低速漫游车运动。公开资源包括软件、配置文件、标注数据集、训练权重和评估日志。在478张保留图像上，检测器在Ultralytics评估器下的mAP@0.5达到0.720，并在统一评估协议下优于经典OpenCV基线方法。所报告的感知延迟在Jetson Orin NX上为25毫秒。三次任务（一次室内、两次室外）展示了标记引导导航和自主返回能力，全程无需操作员运动指令且无碰撞报告。现场结果记录了集成失败及纠正措施；仍需重复仪器化试验以量化物理导航误差和可靠性。
