Authors: Iaroslav Kolomiets, Iaroslav Sheipak, Mikhail Reppo, Vsevolod Egorov, Viktor Chertopolokhov, Isaac Chairez

Leave It Better Than Found: Value-Guided Cooperation in Sequential Tasks Other

ad hoc cooperation value function sharing sequential tasks KNN uncertainty filter multi-robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种无需联合训练的自组织顺序协作方法，通过共享带KNN不确定性滤波的价值函数，在仿真和实际任务中显著提升成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for ad hoc sequential cooperation between robots that have not been jointly trained, by sharing value functions with a KNN-based uncertainty filter, achieving significant success rate improvements in simulated and real-world tasks.

Abstract: We consider the problem of sequential task continuation, where one robot acts in a workspace that has been affected by a previous robot. Current approaches in multi-robot cooperation rely heavily on co-training or co-optimization, assumingthat the robots have access to collective interaction data during the policy training or planning process. However, as increasingly varied robotic embodiments and policies are deployed and operate in the same real-world environment, learning policies for cooperation becomes infeasible due to the combinatorial explosion of possible robot combinations that need to be accounted for. To address this challenge, this paper considers the problem of ad hoc sequential cooperation between robots that have never before operated together in a shared environment. We demonstrate that robots can explicitly communicate their environmental preferences through sharing their value functions, enabling coordination without the need for prior joint training. To ground this exchange and prevent overconfidence in out-of-distribution states, we further introduce a k-nearest neighbors (KNN)- based uncertainty filter. Our method yields an increase of up to 48.5 pp compared with naive or even selfish agents, in task success rates across simulated and real-world experiments, demonstrating that value function transmission between agents is useful not merely as an internal learning tool, but as an effective basis for ad hoc coordination. Website: https://proroklab.github.io/PAVE/

摘要（中文）：我们探讨了顺序任务延续问题，即一个机器人在受先前机器人影响的工作空间中执行任务。当前的多机器人协作方法严重依赖联合训练或联合优化，假设机器人在策略训练或规划过程中能够访问集体交互数据。然而，随着越来越多不同形态和策略的机器人在同一真实环境中部署和运行，由于需要考虑的机器人组合呈组合爆炸式增长，学习协作策略变得不可行。为应对这一挑战，本文研究了从未在共享环境中协同作业过的机器人之间的临时顺序协作问题。我们证明，机器人可以通过共享价值函数来明确表达其环境偏好，从而在无需事先联合训练的情况下实现协调。为进一步夯实这一信息交换的可靠性，并防止在分布外状态下过度自信，我们引入了一种基于k近邻（KNN）的不确定性过滤器。在仿真和真实世界实验中，与朴素甚至自私的智能体相比，我们的方法在任务成功率上提升高达48.5个百分点，这表明智能体之间的价值函数传递不仅作为内部学习工具具有价值，更是实现临时协调的有效基础。网站：https://proroklab.github.io/PAVE/

Development of Anthropomorphic Arm for collaborative and Home Service Robot CHARMIE Manipulation

3D-printed arm teleoperation hand pose estimation Denavit-Hartenberg collaborative robot

简要说明：本论文介绍了一种用于协作和家庭服务机器人的开源3D打印拟人手臂，通过基于机器学习的手部姿态估计的遥操作和基于Denavit-Hartenberg方法的运动学控制来实现控制。

TLDR: This dissertation presents an open-source 3D-printed anthropomorphic arm for collaborative and home service robots, controlled via teleoperation with ML-based hand pose estimation and kinematic control using the Denavit-Hartenberg method.

Abstract: Service Robots are becoming a reality and are progressing by leaps and bounds. Alongside this avenue of robotics is also the field of prosthetics, which is evolving rapidly. These topics are hot cakes in the industry and are widely developed. Some have one quality, and some have others, but are making a shoreline towards success. The development of arm and hand as individual or as a package is becoming common as more and more advanced collaborative robots come to the surface and join their human counterparts in the real world. This dissertation presents an open-source 3D-printed arm which was assembled and programmed on two fronts. The first is the control of the hand by utilising teleoperation with a camera and ML-based hand pose estimation. Secondly, it is the control via kinematics utilising the Denavit-Hartenberg method to define the motion and to find the position of the end effector in 3D space.

摘要（中文）：服务机器人正逐渐成为现实，并以惊人的速度发展。与机器人这一领域并行的还有假肢领域，该领域正在迅速演进。这些主题在业界备受追捧，并得到了广泛的开发。有些产品各具特色，但都在朝着成功的彼岸迈进。随着越来越多先进的协作机器人涌现，并与人类在现实世界中并肩工作，手臂和手作为独立部件或作为一个整体进行开发已变得越来越普遍。本论文介绍了一种开源3D打印手臂，该手臂在两个方面进行了组装与编程。其一是利用相机和基于机器深度学习的手部姿态估计，通过遥操作对手进行控制。其二则是利用运动学进行控制，采用德纳维-哈滕伯格（Denavit-Hartenberg）方法来定义运动，并确定末端执行器在三维空间中的位置。

Authors: Hafiz Adil, Tiago Ribeiro, Antonio Ribeiro, Carolina Lopes, Joana Coelho, Gil Lopes, Fernando Ribeiro

A Unified Fractal Impedance Control Framework Manipulation

Fractal Impedance Control Physical Human-Robot Interaction Harmonic-Passive Motion Paradigm ROS2 MuJoCo

简要说明：本文提出了一种统一的Fractal阻抗控制框架，并引入了新颖的Harmonic-Passive Motion Paradigm (H-PMP)架构，通过在Kinova Gen3机器人上进行的轨迹跟踪、墙壁按压和示教学习实验验证了其有效性。H-PMP实现了导纳和阻抗行为之间的无缝切换，适用于非结构化环境中的安全人机交互。

TLDR: This paper presents a unified framework for Fractal Impedance Control (FIC) with a novel Harmonic-Passive Motion Paradigm (H-PMP) architecture, validated on a physical Kinova Gen3 robot through trajectory tracking, wall press, and learning-by-demonstration experiments. The H-PMP achieves a seamless trade-off between admittance and impedance behaviors for safe physical human-robot interaction in unstructured environments.

Abstract: Physical human--robot interaction requires controllers capable of maintaining intrinsically bounded interactions with the environment. The Fractal Impedance Controller (FIC) has been proven to guarantee these safety characteristics by design. This paper introduces the robotic implementation and experimental validation of its most advanced architecture: the Harmonic-Passive Motion Paradigm (H-PMP), an evolution of the Passive Motion Paradigm designed to mimic human-like interaction. Furthermore, we present a unified framework for FIC deployment, supported by an open-source software suite featuring ROS2, MuJoCo, and physical hardware integrations. Through three experiments conducted on a Kinova Gen3 arm (trajectory tracking, a wall press with sudden loss of contact, and learning-by-demonstration) we compare the H-PMP against earlier FIC architectures. The results demonstrate that the H-PMP achieves a seamless trade-off between admittance and impedance behaviours. This makes it ideal for deployment in unstructured environments, enabling the robot to transition between interaction modes with no computational overhead.

摘要（中文）：物理人机交互要求控制器能够在与环境互动时保持内在有界的交互特性。分形阻抗控制器（FIC）已被证明能够通过设计从原理上保障这些安全特性。本文介绍了其最先进架构——谐波被动运动范式（H-PMP）的机器人实现与实验验证，该范式是被动运动范式的一种演进，旨在模拟类人交互行为。此外，我们提出了一个统一的FIC部署框架，并配套开源软件套件，支持ROS2、MuJoCo及物理硬件集成。通过在Kinova Gen3机械臂上开展的三项实验（轨迹跟踪、突然失去接触的墙壁按压以及示教学习），我们将H-PMP与早期的FIC架构进行了对比。结果表明，H-PMP在导纳与阻抗行为之间实现了无缝权衡，使其非常适合部署于非结构化环境中，使机器人能够在不产生额外计算开销的前提下实现交互模式之间的切换。

Authors: Adnan Takriti, Mahmoud Sadeq, Quentin Rouxel, Daniele Cafolla, Michael Mistry, Carlo Tiseo

Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning Other

structure from collision hypothesis-space reasoning material point method cavity reconstruction differentiable simulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种从碰撞中恢复物体隐藏内部结构（如空腔）的方法，通过将问题重构为假设空间推理，结合无梯度全局搜索和基于梯度的局部细化，利用可微分的物质点法仿真，提升了隐藏结构重建和未来预测的准确性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Structure from Collision (SfC), a method that recovers hidden object cavities from collision-induced surface motion by treating cavity estimation as hypothesis-space reasoning with gradient-free optimization over explicit structural hypotheses and gradient-based refinement, improving reconstruction and prediction over density-based baselines.

Abstract: Knowledge of the hidden interior structure of an object, including the presence and location of cavities, is essential for predictive simulation, robotic manipulation, and nondestructive inspection. However, such cavities leave no direct signature on the static visible surface, making collision-induced deformation one of the few cues used to infer their presence. Structure from Collision (SfC) addresses this problem by recovering the hidden interior structure of an object from multiview observations of a collision event. SfC is challenging for two reasons: hidden cavities are only indirectly observable through surface motion, and voids correspond to the absence of material, making direct optimization using standard density representations difficult. The density-based SfC baseline inherits both difficulties. Surface-matching gradients do not directly indicate the cavity location, while density gradients can be weak or uninformative inside or near void regions. Therefore, we reformulate SfC as hypothesis-space reasoning, representing hidden cavities as explicit structural hypotheses whose variables encode available structural assumptions rather than relying on implicit density updates. A global stage performs gradient-free optimization over this hypothesis space using forward-only material point method (MPM) simulation. A local stage then refines the selected hypothesis as a Lagrangian particle system through gradient-based optimization using differentiable MPM simulation. On the SfC benchmark, our method improves hidden-structure reconstruction and future prediction over the density-based SfC baseline. Interior-topology stress tests and robustness analyses characterize its scope and limitations. The project page is available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/.

摘要（中文）：物体隐藏内部结构（包括空洞的存在及其位置）的知识对于预测性仿真、机器人操作和无损检测至关重要。然而，这些空洞在静态可见表面上不会留下直接痕迹，使得碰撞引起的变形成为推断其存在的少数线索之一。碰撞结构恢复（Structure from Collision, SfC）通过从碰撞事件的多视角观测中恢复物体的隐藏内部结构来解决这一问题。SfC面临两大挑战：隐藏空洞仅能通过表面运动间接观测，且空洞对应材料的缺失，使得使用标准密度表示的直接优化变得困难。基于密度的SfC基线方法同时继承了这两个难点。表面匹配梯度不能直接指示空洞位置，而空洞内部或其附近的密度梯度可能较弱或缺乏信息量。因此，我们将SfC重新构建为假设空间推理问题，将隐藏空洞表示为显式结构假设，其变量编码了可用的结构假设，而非依赖隐式密度更新。全局阶段仅使用前向物质点法（MPM）模拟，在该假设空间中进行无梯度优化。局部阶段则通过基于梯度的优化，利用可微MPM模拟，将选定的假设细化为拉格朗日粒子系统。在SfC基准测试上，我们的方法在隐藏结构重建和未来预测方面优于基于密度的SfC基线。内部拓扑压力测试和鲁棒性分析刻画了该方法的适用范围与局限性。项目页面可在 https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/sfc-hypothesis/ 查阅。

Authors: Takuhiro Kaneko

Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents Other

Goal interpretation Embodied Agent Interface Large Language Models Preference learning Symbolic goal

简要说明：本文提出了一种两阶段生成-排序方法，将自然语言指令转换为具身代理可执行的正式符号目标，通过监督微调LLM和基于偏好学习的排序器（CORE）实现。在Embodied Agent Interface基准上的实验表明，该方法优于基线LLM提示、思维链和知识图谱方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces a two-stage generate-then-rank approach for translating natural language instructions into formal symbolic goals for embodied agents, using supervised fine-tuning of LLMs followed by a preference-learning ranker (CORE). Experiments on the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark show it outperforms baseline LLM prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph methods.

Abstract: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.

摘要（中文）：目标解释是指将自然语言指令转化为规划器可执行的正式符号化目标。这一过程对于具身智能体至关重要，因为此处出现的任何错误都会传导至下游的每一个规划与行动步骤。要做好这一点，既需要生成合适的候选目标，也需要在候选项中可靠地进行筛选。我们提出了一种面向具身智能体接口（EAI）中目标解释问题的两阶段“先生成后排序”方法。首先，通过监督微调使大语言模型（LLM）适应EAI的输出规范。其次，基于错误的候选输出排序方法（CORE）从模型自身生成的备选方案中学习对完整输出的偏好。我们在具身智能体接口基准测试的家庭场景上开展了实验，评估了多个开源大语言模型，包括DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner，以及Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B。实验结果表明，所提出的方法优于包括简单提示、思维链和基于知识图谱方法在内的各类基线模型。

Authors: Jisen Lei, Huizhi Liang

Flexible Piezoelectric Tactile Sensing System for Intelligent Object Recognition Other

tactile sensing object recognition piezoelectric robotic grasping edge computing

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人抓取早期物体识别的柔性压电触觉传感系统，评估了多种分类方法，并在嵌入式平台上实现了高F1分数、实时且节能的物体识别。

TLDR: This paper presents a flexible piezoelectric tactile sensing system for early-stage object recognition during robotic grasping, evaluating multiple classification approaches and achieving high F1-scores with real-time, energy-efficient deployment on an embedded platform.

Abstract: Tactile sensing provides information about object properties that can improve robotic grasping and manipulation. However, accurate object recognition during the early stages of grasping remains challenging, particularly under strict real-time constraints. This study presents a flexible, distributed piezoelectric tactile sensing system for early-stage object recognition. The system was experimentally evaluated using six everyday objects and three recognition approaches: feature-based classification using support vector machines (SVMs), raw-signal classification using 1D convolutional neural networks (1D-CNNs) and convolutional recurrent neural networks (C-RNNs), and spatiotemporal heatmap classification using a 2D-CNN. The effects of sensor count and temporal window size on recognition accuracy and real-time feasibility were systematically investigated. Increasing the number of sensing elements improved recognition performance across all approaches. The best-performing method, based on spatiotemporal heatmaps and a 2D-CNN, achieved F1-scores of 0.9796, 0.9846, and 0.9903 using 16, 24, and 32 sensors, respectively. The optimal configuration, comprising 32 sensors and a 100-ms temporal window (50 samples), was deployed on an embedded edge platform, achieving an end-to-end recognition latency of approximately 101 ms from contact onset and an energy consumption of 63.8 microjoules per inference. These results demonstrate the potential of distributed piezoelectric tactile sensing for accurate, energy-efficient, and real-time object recognition during robotic grasping.

摘要（中文）：触觉传感能够提供物体属性的相关信息，从而提升机器人的抓取与操作能力。然而，在抓取初期实现准确的目标识别仍具挑战性，尤其是在严格的实时性约束条件下。本研究提出了一种柔性分布式压电触觉传感系统，用于抓取初期的物体识别。研究选用六种日常物品，并通过三种识别方法对系统进行了实验评估：基于支持向量机（SVM）的特征分类方法、基于一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）和卷积递归神经网络（C-RNN）的原始信号分类方法，以及基于二维卷积神经网络（2D-CNN）的时空热图分类方法。系统性地研究了传感器数量和时间窗口大小对识别精度及实时可行性的影响。增加传感单元数量在所有方法中均显著提升了识别性能。其中，基于时空热图与2D-CNN的最优方法在16、24和32个传感器配置下分别取得了0.9796、0.9846和0.9903的F1分数。最优配置（32个传感器、100毫秒时间窗口，即50个采样点）已在嵌入式边缘平台上部署，实现了从接触开始约101毫秒的端到端识别延迟，以及每次推理63.8微焦耳的能耗。上述结果表明，分布式压电触觉传感在机器人抓取过程中具备实现高精度、低能耗和实时物体识别的潜力。

Authors: Razan Khalifeh, Mohamad Yaacoub, Christian Gianoglio, Moustafa Saleh, Maurizio Valle, Yahya Abbass

Which Objects Stay? Learning Hierarchical Persistence Beliefs for Lifelong Open-Vocabulary Object Maps Other

persistence filter open-vocabulary object maps retrieval-based prior lifelong mapping 3RScan

简要说明：HiPer 提出一种分层持久性过滤器，从检索到的训练实例中推导开放词汇物体的持久性信念，无需类别标签，在模拟和真实 3D 环境中优于基线方法。

TLDR: HiPer introduces a hierarchical persistence filter that derives open-vocabulary object persistence beliefs from retrieved training instances, without class labels, outperforming baselines in simulated and real 3D environments.

Abstract: Lifelong object maps must estimate whether an object remains at its previously observed location after it leaves view. Existing persistence filters rely on class-based survival priors, making them difficult to apply reliably in open-vocabulary settings. We introduce HiPer, a hierarchical persistence filter that derives persistence beliefs directly from data rather than semantic categories. For a new object, HiPer retrieves visually and geometrically similar training instances and estimates an initial survival rate from their observed histories, without requiring class labels. This estimate initializes a conjugate Beta belief over the object's survival probability, which is updated in closed form using detections and missed observations under Rosen's persistence-filter framework. When an object is re-identified at a new location, its persistence belief is transferred with the object, enabling the map to learn object-specific mobility over time. Experiments on 120 held-out simulated sequences show that HiPer consistently achieves the best performance among competing methods. Retrieval-based priors outperform CLIP-derived label priors, and object-specific online learning provides further gains. Results on 47 held-out 3RScan environments demonstrate that the proposed retrieval-based prior also outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in real-world settings.

摘要（中文）：长期目标地图必须估计物体在离开视野后是否仍停留在先前观测到的位置。现有的持久性过滤器依赖基于类别的存活先验，这使得它们在开放词汇场景中难以可靠应用。我们提出HiPer，一种分层持久性过滤器，它直接从数据而非语义类别中推导持久性信念。对于新物体，HiPer检索视觉和几何上相似的训练实例，并根据其观测历史估计初始存活率，无需类别标签。该估计值初始化了物体存活概率上的共轭Beta信念，并在Rosen持久性过滤器框架下，利用检测和漏检观测以闭式形式进行更新。当物体在新位置被重新识别时，其持久性信念随物体一同转移，使地图能够随时间学习物体特有的移动性。在120个保留模拟序列上的实验表明，HiPer在竞争方法中持续取得最佳性能。基于检索的先验优于基于CLIP的标签先验，且物体特有的在线学习带来进一步增益。在47个保留3RScan环境上的结果表明，所提出的基于检索的先验在真实世界场景中同样优于最先进的基线方法。

Authors: Thanh Nguyen Canh, Haolan Zhang, Nak Young Chong

Unified Overview of Safety Certificate Functions: Techniques from Hamilton--Jacobi Reachability and Control Barrier Functions Other

safety certificates Hamilton-Jacobi reachability control barrier functions safety-critical control vehicle systems

简要说明：本教程统一概述了使用Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析与控制障碍函数的安全证书合成方法，并通过车辆系统基准比较了不同方法在安全关键控制中的有效性。

TLDR: This tutorial provides a unified overview of safety certificate synthesis using Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis and control barrier functions, including benchmark comparisons for safety-critical control of vehicle systems.

Abstract: Safety is a central concern in modern autonomous systems. Safety certificates---functions whose existence guarantees that a system meets its safety specification---have long been used as a principled tool for rigorously reasoning about safety. Methods for synthesizing such certificates are scattered across research areas, with little guidance on when to use a particular approach. This tutorial provides a holistic treatment of safety certificate synthesis centered on two widely used families: Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis and control barrier functions (CBFs). For each family of methods, we first introduce its general formulation, along with classical and learning-based tools for certificate synthesis. Next, we introduce two benchmark problems consisting of vehicle systems of differing complexity to assess the certificate quality of different synthesis methods and their effectiveness in safety-critical control. We use these benchmarks to compare various methods and provide practical guidance for selecting an approach.

摘要（中文）：安全性是现代自主系统中的核心关注点。安全证书——其存在即保证系统满足其安全规格的函数——长期以来一直被用作严谨推理安全性的原则性工具。用于综合此类证书的方法分散于各个研究领域，关于何时采用特定方法的指导却寥寥无几。本教程围绕两大广泛使用的方法族，对安全证书综合进行了整体性论述：Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析与控制障碍函数 (CBFs)。针对每一方法族，我们首先介绍其一般性表述，以及用于证书综合的经典与基于学习的工具。接下来，我们引入两个由复杂度不同的车辆系统构成的基准问题，以评估不同综合方法的证书质量及其在安全关键控制中的有效性。我们利用这些基准对各方法进行比较，并为选择合适方法提供实践指导。

Authors: Hao Wang, Max Cohen, Zeyuan Feng, Donggeon David Oh, Oswin So, Songyuan Zhang, Javier Borquez, Chuchu Fan, Jaime Fernández Fisac, Haimin Hu, Jason J. Choi, Somil Bansal

Curvature by Design: A Support Structure for Continuum Robots Other

continuum robots curvature constraint compliant flexure joints tendon actuation shape precision

简要说明：本文提出一种基于剪刀机构与柔性铰链的支撑结构，通过机械约束使连续体机器人实现预设的恒定或变化曲率，提高形状精度并抵抗非期望变形。

TLDR: This paper introduces a scissor-based support structure with compliant flexure joints that mechanically enforces prescribed constant or variable curvature profiles in continuum robots, improving shape precision and robustness to external loads.

Abstract: Constant- and piecewise-constant-curvature models are widely used to simplify the kinematics of continuum robots, although the assumed curvature profiles are not necessarily inherent mechanical properties of the robot and may therefore be violated during operation. Rather than assuming a prescribed curvature profile in the kinematic model and estimating deviations from it, this paper presents a multi-segment scissor-based support structure that mechanically constrains a continuum robot to exhibit prescribed constant or spatially varying curvature profiles. The design uses Taylor approximations to enable an overconstrained multi-joint linkage to predictably distribute global bending among the small-angle movements of multiple flexures. The geometric coupling is realized using compliant flexure joints, enabling the support structure to be manufactured as a single piece. The structure is integrated with a tendon-actuated continuum robot with a flexible backbone. Experiments show that the structure makes the robot resistant to deformations other than the prescribed curvature, significantly enhancing shape precision compared to classical flexible-backbone designs. This constrains the robot from making S-shapes when external loads are applied in the opposite direction of the bending. By mechanically constraining the admissible deformation, the proposed structure reduces the number of independent shape variables that must be estimated.

摘要（中文）：常曲率和分段常曲率模型被广泛用于简化连续体机器人的运动学，尽管所假设的曲率分布并不一定是机器人的固有机械属性，因此在操作过程中可能被违背。本文不再在运动学模型中预设曲率分布并估计其偏差，而是提出一种基于多段剪刀式支撑结构的设计，通过机械约束使连续体机器人表现出预设的常曲率或空间变化曲率分布。该设计利用泰勒近似，使过约束多关节连杆能够将全局弯曲可预测地分配至多个柔性关节的小角度运动中。几何耦合通过柔性铰链实现，使支撑结构能够整体一体化制造。该结构与采用柔性骨架的腱驱动连续体机器人集成。实验表明，该结构使机器人抵抗除预设曲率以外的变形，相比经典柔性骨架设计显著提升了形状精度。当外部载荷沿弯曲反方向施加时，该结构约束机器人避免形成S形。通过机械约束允许的变形，所提出的结构减少了需要估计的独立形状变量数量。

Authors: Justus Sagemüller, Harald Minde Hansen, Kristin Y. Pettersen

BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories Other

Embodied AI Multimodal LLM Self-Driving Labs Action Grounding Benchmark

简要说明：BEAKER 提出了一个由专家策划的基准，包含 1000 个问答样本，涵盖 11 种图像/视频任务类型，用于评估多模态大模型作为自驾驶化学实验室具身大脑的能力，揭示了粗粒度程序理解与精确动作接地感知之间的差距。

TLDR: BEAKER introduces an expert-curated benchmark of 1,000 QA samples across 11 image/video task types to evaluate multimodal LLMs as embodied brains for self-driving chemical laboratories, revealing gaps between coarse procedure understanding and precise action-grounded perception.

Abstract: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.

摘要（中文）：自主驱动化学实验室（SDCL）正将化学实验推向具身自动化，其中机器必须感知实验室场景、推理实验状态，并在物理、流程和安全约束下执行操作。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）日益被视为此类系统的具身大脑，但现有实验室基准主要聚焦于安全性、异常检测或一般性科学理解，其面向执行的具身能力尚未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了BEAKER，一个用于评估SDCL中具身可操作性、知识、实验与推理能力的基准。BEAKER包含1,000个由专家精心设计的问题-答案样本，涵盖11种图像与视频任务类型，覆盖化学实验室执行所需的关键判断能力，包括功能可供性定位、轨迹规划、设备识别、状态识别、安全识别、装置搭建、操作与步骤推理，以及时序流程推理。所有问题与标注均由化学及具身人工智能（AI）领域专家人工创建和审核，未使用AI辅助生成或标注。我们在离线、单轮设置下评估了28个通用型、科学导向型、化学专精型及具身型MLLMs。结果表明，当前模型能够跟踪视频中的粗略实验流程，但在将动作落实到可操作区域和可行轨迹、识别细粒度实验室设备、状态与安全规范，以及对中等长度流程中的步骤进行排序方面仍存在困难。因此，BEAKER揭示了粗略程序理解与实验室执行所需的精确、基于动作的感知之间的明显差距，为未来SDCL中的MLLMs提供了一个诊断性基准。

Authors: Fei Lin, Tengchao Zhang, Ziyang Gong, Xiaotong Yu, Bohan Zhang, Yifan Zhou, Qihao Yang, Ji Dai, Dong Li, Yining Jiang, Qinghua Ni, Jun Huang, Qiang Zhang, Yue Zhou, Zhihang Zhong, Yonglin Tian, Fei-Yue Wang, Xue Yang

PVDepth: Panoramic Video Depth Estimation via Geometry-Aware Spatiotemporal Adaptation Perception3D

panoramic video depth estimation Equirectangular Projection synthetic dataset cube-rectified temporal modeling sphere-aware noise initialization

简要说明：PVDepth 提出了一个全景视频深度估计框架，并引入大规模合成数据集 PanoCARLA 以及两种核心机制来解决 ERP 特有的畸变和时间动态问题，从而提升深度估计的精度和一致性，适用于 VR 和世界模型等应用。

TLDR: PVDepth introduces a panoramic video depth estimation framework with a large-scale synthetic dataset (PanoCARLA) and two core mechanisms to address ERP-specific distortions and temporal dynamics, improving depth accuracy and consistency for VR and world model applications.

Abstract: Panoramic video depth estimation is pivotal for applications such as Virtual Reality and World Models. However, advancements in this field are impeded by two primary obstacles: the scarcity of large-scale training data and the unique spatiotemporal challenges of Equirectangular Projection (ERP), which hinder the direct transfer of perspective models. In this paper, we first present PanoCARLA, a large-scale synthetic RGB-D panoramic video dataset, featuring natural motion trajectories and drone-like roaming perspectives. Building on this foundation, we propose PVDepth, an end-to-end framework adapted from perspective video depth models. To tackle ERP-specific geometric distortions and consequent non-linear temporal dynamics, we introduce two core mechanisms: (1) A Progressive Sphere-aware Noise Initialization strategy that anneals the noise distribution from planar to spherical, guiding the model to adapt to non-uniform information density; and (2) A Cube-rectified Temporal Modeling module that incorporates an auxiliary cubemap temporal branch to rectify non-linear temporal dynamics in the ERP domain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PVDepth achieves superior performance, generating geometrically accurate and temporally consistent depth sequences. Code and data will be released at https:// github.com/ChuanxinSong/PVDepth.

摘要（中文）：全景视频深度估计对于虚拟现实和世界模型等应用至关重要。然而，该领域的发展受到两大障碍的制约：大规模训练数据的匮乏，以及等距柱状投影（ERP）特有的时空挑战，这些挑战阻碍了透视模型的直接迁移。本文首先提出了PanoCARLA，一个大规模合成RGB-D全景视频数据集，具有自然运动轨迹和无人机式漫游视角。在此基础上，我们提出了PVDepth，一个从透视视频深度模型改编而来的端到端框架。为应对ERP特有的几何畸变及其导致的非线性时间动态，我们引入了两个核心机制：（1）渐进式球面感知噪声初始化策略，将噪声分布从平面退火至球面，引导模型适应非均匀信息密度；（2）立方体校正的时间建模模块，引入辅助立方体贴图时间分支以校正ERP域中的非线性时间动态。大量实验表明，PVDepth取得了卓越的性能，生成了几何精确且时间一致的深度序列。代码和数据将在 https://github.com/ChuanxinSong/PVDepth 发布。
